example.en: She was coughing all the time.
example.zh: 她一直在咳嗽。

example.en: This is usually the case.
example.zh: 通常都是这样。

example.en: Glasgow has pledged to take the lead in reducing carbon emissions in the UK.
example.zh: 格拉斯哥已承诺在英国带头减少碳排放。

example.en: This was the first record of six babies being born at the same time in that region.
example.zh: 这是该地区首次有六个婴儿同时出生的记录。

example.en: But on the whole, there was no systematic pattern.
example.zh: 但总体上没有系统性的规律。

example.en: He can take notes on the spot.
example.zh: 他可以当场做笔记。

example.en: How the man got into the habit of being wasteful.
example.zh: 那个男人是怎么养成浪费习惯的。

example.en: It has been on the decline.
example.zh: 它一直在下降。

example.en: suggests that narrow winners become even bigger winners down the line.
example.zh: 这表明小赢家以后会变成更大的赢家。

example.en: It is open round the clock.
example.zh: 它全天候营业。

example.en: students with electronic tablets loaded with assignments to complete in the event of a school closure.
example.zh: 为学生配备装有作业的电子平板，以便在学校停课时完成。

example.en: It has to be carried out to the letter.
example.zh: 它必须被严格执行。

example.en: The circumstances remain a mystery so we would welcome any information that will help us get to the bottom of these random incidents.
example.zh: 我们欢迎任何有助于我们查明这些随机事件真相的信息。

example.en: To enjoy the sports to the full.
example.zh: 尽情享受这些运动。

the thing is.zh: 问题是，事实是（引出关键点）

example.en: Maybe you’re right, but the thing is, everyone at the office has a nice, expensive phone, and I’m a little embarrassed by mine.
example.zh: 也许你是对的，但问题是，办公室里每个人都有一部漂亮昂贵的手机，我对自己的手机有点难为情。

example.en: For now the only way to stop fraudsters appears ultimately to lie in the hands of the consumer.
example.zh: 目前阻止诈骗者的唯一办法最终似乎取决于消费者。

example.en: Actually my mother is terrified of airplanes to the point where she can’t even fly.
example.zh: 其实我妈妈特别怕坐飞机，甚至到了不敢坐的地步。

example.en: A substantial part of this, they report, is “widespread ageism” on the part of hiring managers.
example.zh: 他们报告说，其中很大一部分是招聘经理方面普遍存在的年龄歧视。

example.en: To put it plainly, we just weren’t on the same page.
example.zh: 直白地说，我们就是没有达成共识。

example.en: It is important to understand what causes your stress in the first place.
example.zh: 弄清楚是什么首先造成了你的压力很重要。

example.en: Um, I’m thinking team sports should be the way to go.
example.zh: 嗯，我觉得团队运动应该是最好的选择。

example.en: Well, I think that was quite a successful trip in the end.
example.zh: 嗯，我觉得最后这次旅行相当成功。

example.en: It’s gained through experience on the job and learning what’s appropriate given the needs of the project.
example.zh: 它是通过工作中的经验，以及了解项目需要什么而获得的。

on the job.note: 字面可推（在工作中），不必当固定短语单独背

example.en: But in the long term their performance is negatively affected.
example.zh: 但从长远来看，他们的表现会受到负面影响。

example.en: studies, and the like.
example.zh: 研究，诸如此类。

think outside the box.zh: 跳出常规思考，打破思维定式

example.en: Similarly, being creative involves “thinking outside the box”, deviating from expectations.
example.zh: 同样，有创造力意味着“跳出框框思考”，偏离人们的预期。

example.en: How will we fund the rewards in the meantime?
example.zh: 在此期间我们该如何为奖励提供资金？

example.en: You'll travel through as much of the store as possible, and be tempted along the way.
example.zh: 你会穿过尽可能多的商店区域，并在途中被诱惑。

example.en: psychological boost, or the proverbial kick in the pants.
example.zh: 心理上的鼓励，或者说人们常说的“当头一棒”式鞭策。

example.en: On the contrary, taking risks in entrepreneurship involves careful planning and hard work.
example.zh: 相反，创业中冒险需要周密的计划和努力工作。

example.en: The games are coming back for the first time in 5 years.
example.zh: 运动会时隔五年再次回归。

for the first time.note: 字面可推（第一次），可按 time 的义项标

example.en: Across the board, people are living longer.
example.zh: 总体来看，人们的寿命都在延长。

example.en: The study found that while the bigger display table created more interest, people were almost 10 times less likely to purchase a jar of jam than in the case of the smaller display.
example.zh: 研究发现，虽然较大的展示桌引起了更多兴趣，但人们购买一罐果酱的可能性比较小展示桌的情况低了近十倍。

example.en: To tell the truth, interesting people are more popular among their friends.
example.zh: 说实话，有趣的人在朋友中更受欢迎。

example.en: All of this was done in the name of increasing job satisfaction and giving workers greater flexibility,
example.zh: 这一切都是以提高工作满意度、给员工更大灵活性的名义进行的。

example.en: In many cases, learning for the sake of learning can
example.zh: 在许多情况下，为学习而学习可以……

change the game.zh: 改变游戏规则，带来变革

example.en: Even though we are living in an age where growing old is thought of as an inevitable misery, this doctor has been changing the game for seniors over the last 25 years.
example.zh: 尽管我们生活在一个认为变老是不可避免的苦难的时代，这位医生25年来一直在改变老年人的处境。

example.en: We should stay persistent even in the face of failures.
example.zh: 即使面对失败，我们也应该坚持。

in the face of.note: 真题原句写作 in face of，规范写法为 in the face of

example.en: But at the very least, the research is
example.zh: 但至少，这项研究是……

example.en: It’s the same as conflicts.
example.zh: 这和冲突是一样的。

example.en: On the one hand, many see value in diversity, which can contribute a variety of perspectives, encourage new ideas, and generate innovative solutions.
example.zh: 一方面，许多人看重多样性，它能带来多种视角、激发新想法并产生创新的解决方案。

example.en: On the other hand, a casual dress helps us become more friendly and creative.
example.zh: 另一方面，休闲着装能让我们更友好、更有创造力。

in the grand scheme of things.canonical: in the grand scheme of things

example.en: In the grand scheme of things, however, colleges also must come to understand that the hidden fees they ask for may prove unmanageable for the very kinds of low-income or first-generation students they are trying desperately to attract.
example.zh: 然而，从大局来看，高校也必须明白，它们收取的隐性费用对它们极力想吸引的低收入或第一代大学生来说可能难以承受。

example.en: about being able to put food on the table.
example.zh: 关于能够养家糊口。

example.en: From there you are going to have to legally change your name all over the place.
example.zh: 接下来你得在各处依法更改自己的姓名。

example.en: It may get in the way of enhancing one's social status.
example.zh: 它可能会妨碍提升一个人的社会地位。

at the end of the day.canonical: at the end of the day

example.en: At the end of the day, whether you each keep your names, whether you come up with an entirely new name for the two of you to share or whether you hyphenate your current last names, what matters is that you love each other and are going to be joining your lives together.
example.zh: 归根结底，无论你们各自保留姓氏，还是想出一个全新的姓氏共用，还是把现有的姓氏连起来，重要的是你们彼此相爱，并将携手共度人生。

example.en: In the U.S., 29% of drivers admit they surf behind the wheel, according to insurance firm State Farm.
example.zh: 在美国，29%的司机承认开车时上网。

example.en: Phrases like “I have limited access to email” and “I’ll respond as soon as I get back” sound like you’re being held against your will from working as opposed to making the most of your time off.
example.zh: 这些话听起来像是你被迫不能工作，而不是充分利用你的休假时间。

make the most of.note: sents 里还有 get the most out of 的写法（同义），已并入

example.en: One group presented their idea in the form of a puppet show and we see
example.zh: 一组人以木偶戏的形式展示了他们的想法，我们看到……

example.en: Most of us are not in the habit of exercising self-control.
example.zh: 我们大多数人没有自我控制的习惯。

example.en: Economic growth benefits people little in the long run.
example.zh: 从长远来看，经济增长给人们带来的好处很少。

on the market.zh: 在市场上出售的，上市的

example.en: processed meatless substitutes on the market today.
example.zh: 如今市面上的加工素肉替代品。

on the market.note: 字面可推（在市场上），不必当固定短语

example.en: He is going to visit a friend.
example.zh: 他打算去看望一位朋友。

example.en: He has to work late.
example.zh: 他得工作到很晚。

example.en: Giving kids pocket money according to their needs.
example.zh: 按孩子的需要给零花钱。

example.en: It can give rise to gender bias.
example.zh: 它可能引发性别偏见。

example.en: This was due to the risk of bird flu.
example.zh: 这是由于禽流感的风险。

example.en: It brought the mine’s operations to a halt.
example.zh: 它使矿场的运营陷入停顿。

come to a halt.note: sents 中还有 bring...to a halt、grind to a halt 等变化形式

example.en: She is too eager to please.
example.zh: 她太急于取悦别人了。

example.en: The golden rule must sometimes give way to more important principles.
example.zh: 黄金法则有时必须让位于更重要的原则。

example.en: It has much to do with one’s genes.
example.zh: 这与一个人的基因有很大关系。

have to do with.note: 与 have something to do with 是同一短语，合并

example.en: What do supporters say in response to the restaurant’s new policy?
example.zh: 支持者们对餐厅的新政策有什么回应？

used to.zh: 过去常常，曾经（现已不是）

example.en: He used to be a helicopter pilot.
example.zh: 他过去是一名直升机飞行员。

example.en: Two boys and four girls were born on Monday to the surprise of a young couple and doctors who had expected five babies.
example.zh: 周一，两个男孩和四个女孩出生了，这让一对年轻夫妇和原本预计是五胞胎的医生们大吃一惊。

up to.zh: 多达，最多；由……决定，取决于；达到

example.en: That’s definitely up to you.
example.zh: 那绝对由你决定。

up to.note: 真题里「多达」更常见；本例句取义项靠前时可换 id 2 "They are reused up to 100 times."

example.en: “Kids still spend time face to face,” Lenhart says.
example.zh: “孩子们仍然会面对面相处，”伦哈特说。

example.en: He looks forward to receiving presents from his close friends.
example.zh: 他期待着收到亲密朋友送的礼物。

example.en: What should we take into account in order to make informed decisions?
example.zh: 为了做出明智的决定，我们应该考虑什么？

example.en: She can no longer hold on to her job.
example.zh: 她再也保不住自己的工作了。

example.en: It is located next to a hat factory.
example.zh: 它位于一家帽子工厂旁边。

example.en: Absorbing new information is helpful in making better decisions prior to action.
example.zh: 在行动之前吸收新信息有助于做出更好的决定。

example.en: Not to mention the great physical benefits from exercising outside every day.
example.zh: 更不用说每天在户外锻炼对身体的诸多好处了。

example.en: She is used to taking public transport.
example.zh: 她习惯了乘坐公共交通。

example.en: Stories vary about how lion dancing came to be, but most of them include a monster named Nian who would terrorize a village.
example.zh: 关于舞狮是如何形成的有不同的说法，但大多数都提到一个会祸害村庄的怪兽“年”。

example.en: Changing one’s form of communication from time to time.
example.zh: 不时改变沟通方式。

example.en: It is as famous as Cape Town.
example.zh: 它和开普敦一样有名。

example.en: To begin with, job applicants should be clear what they expect from their future employer.
example.zh: 首先，求职者应该明确他们对未来雇主有什么期待。

to a point.zh: 在某种程度上，到一定程度

example.en: That’s a little gloomy, but I can understand that to a point.
example.zh: 有点悲观，但我在某种程度上能理解。

example.en: It has much to do with one’s genes.
example.zh: 这与一个人的基因有很大关系。

have something to do with.note: 与 have to do with 是同一短语，合并到 have to do with

example.en: That’s definitely up to you.
example.zh: 这绝对由你来决定。

example.en: So as you can see, when it comes to choices, less is more.
example.zh: 如你所见，说到选择，少即是多。

get around to.zh: 抽出时间做（拖了很久的事）

example.en: I was given three books over Christmas, and I’m only now getting around to reading them.
example.zh: 圣诞节我收到了三本书，现在才抽出时间去读。

example.en: Remember that you will have to have all your certificates to hand when you are filling out the forms.
example.zh: 记住，填表时你得把所有证书放在手边。

to hand.note: 英式用法，常作 at hand；例句截取了原句前半

example.en: Creating an ideal working environment will make it easier for them to get down to their assignments quickly.
example.zh: 营造理想的工作环境会让他们更容易迅速投入到任务中。

example.en: In one study, they were given matrixes and had to find two numbers that added up to 10.
example.zh: 在一项研究中，他们拿到一些矩阵，要找出两个相加等于10的数。

add up to.note: 例句删去了括号里的中文注释

example.en: In addition to tuition, college students have to pay extra fees for the courses they take.
example.zh: 除了学费，大学生还要为所修课程支付额外费用。

example.en: They fell victim to eagles.
example.zh: 它们成了老鹰的猎物。

example.en: If I am caught with it in my pocket, I will be subject to disciplinary procedure, which will impact on my career.
example.zh: 如果被发现我口袋里有这个，我就要接受纪律处分，这会影响我的职业生涯。

example.en: It will also bring to an end a less popular US high school tradition: the “make-up day”
example.zh: 这也将终结美国高中一项不太受欢迎的传统：“补课日”。

bring sth to an end.note: 真题里宾语后置：bring to an end sth

example.en: It all comes down to the difference between learning and practicing.
example.zh: 这一切归结为学习和练习之间的区别。

example.en: Pay attention to the differences between genders.
example.zh: 要注意性别之间的差异。

example.en: People's opinions differ as to whether Formula One can be promoted in the U.S.
example.zh: 人们对一级方程式赛车能否在美国推广看法不一。

example.en: Much to the delight of local children, the eggs contained toys.
example.zh: 令当地孩子们高兴的是，这些蛋里装着玩具。

much to sb's delight.note: 原句 delight 处是空格（_28_），例句由我改写补全

example.en: This research found college students were more likely to choose healthy food in the presence of an observer of a different race, as opposed to an observer from their own race.
example.zh: 这项研究发现，大学生在有不同种族的观察者在场时，比有同种族观察者在场时更可能选择健康食物。

as opposed to.note: 例句较长，其他句子更长或被截断；去掉了句首 [16] 编号

example.en: But to be honest, I’d prefer something hot, not cold.
example.zh: 但说实话，我更想要热的，而不是冷的。

to be honest.note: 变体 to be perfectly honest 也归此

example.en: Turn to her parents for help.
example.zh: 向她的父母求助。

look to.zh: 指望，依靠；打算，期望；展望

example.en: Across the U.S., families are looking to the winter with fear as energy costs soar.
example.zh: 在美国各地，随着能源成本飙升，家庭们担忧地展望着冬天。

look to.note: 义项较杂：依靠/打算/展望，例句取最完整的一句

example.en: Fraudsters advertise their villas at reasonable prices so as not to be suspected.
example.zh: 骗子以合理的价格宣传他们的别墅，以免被怀疑。

so as to.note: 含否定形式 so as not to

example.en: This is not to say you should never attend another meeting.
example.zh: 这并不是说你再也不该参加会议。

not to say.note: 例句截取了原句前半；常见完整形式 that is not to say that

example.en: In relation to the intensity of anaerobic exercise, however, the results were far clearer.
example.zh: 然而就无氧运动的强度而言，结果清楚得多。

example.en: Still, the only “new-to-me” topics that came to mind were my daughter’s basketball tournament and my feelings about that morning’s political headlines.
example.zh: 不过，我想到的唯一“新鲜”话题是女儿的篮球锦标赛和我对当天早上政治头条的感受。

come to mind.note: 例句删去了括号里的中文注释并截取前半

example.en: Contrary to parents’ belief, kids try hard to leave as few traces as possible on the web.
example.zh: 与家长的想法相反，孩子们努力在网上少留痕迹。

example.en: Gain instruction in new skills, thanks to the internet.
example.zh: 多亏了互联网，人们能学到新技能。

example.en: Businesses are waking up to the skills gamers can bring
example.zh: 企业开始认识到游戏玩家能带来的技能。

example.en: He has benefited to a great extent from a tiny hearing device in his ear.
example.zh: 他在很大程度上得益于耳朵里的一个小型助听器。

example.en: Not only do we not want to see lives go to waste
example.zh: 我们不仅不想看到生命被白白浪费

go to waste.note: 例句为被截断的句子片段

example.en: Owing to the internet, it is now more convenient than ever to receive training in new skills.
example.zh: 由于互联网，如今接受新技能培训比以往任何时候都方便。

example.en: Parents often hear that reading to their children is critical for supporting development, and the message is getting through to them.
example.zh: 家长们常听说给孩子读书对促进发展至关重要，这个信息正在被他们接受。

example.en: Slim to none—believe me, I’ve looked.
example.zh: 微乎其微，相信我，我找过了。

example.en: This is in contrast to books that did not name images, or books that had the same label under each image.
example.zh: 这与没有给图片命名的书，或每张图下标签都相同的书形成对比。

example.en: Simply put, countries stick to darker and more conservative colors because they appear more official.
example.zh: 简单地说，各国坚持使用更深、更保守的颜色，因为它们看起来更正式。

example.en: He recalled attending Formula One's Monaco race last year and being overwhelmed by the ceremony leading up to the event.
example.zh: 他回忆起去年观看摩纳哥一级方程式大赛，被赛前的仪式震撼了。

example.en: To this day, Red Rum’s third win is known as one of the greatest moments in horse racing history.
example.zh: 直到今天，红朗姆的第三次夺冠仍被称为赛马史上最伟大的时刻之一。

example.en: Job satisfaction has a lot to do with company culture.
example.zh: 工作满意度与公司文化关系很大。

have much to do with.note: 真题里 much 和 a lot 两种写法并存，规范写法按给定的 have much to do with

example.en: There are close to 58,000 homeless people in Los Angeles county.
example.zh: 洛杉矶县有近58,000名无家可归者。

close to.note: 作“将近”讲时是固定用法；作“靠近”则只是普通搭配，此处只有“将近”

example.en: It is important to talk through these issues before they come to a head.
example.zh: 在这些问题激化之前把它们谈开很重要。

example.en: Until genetic engineering comes to fruition, other strategies might also help in some places.
example.zh: 在基因工程见效之前，其他策略在一些地方也可能有帮助。

come to fruition.note: 例句删去了句首 K) 并截取前半

example.en: students believed that intelligence could improve-that is to say, when they held more of a growth
example.zh: 学生相信智力可以提高，也就是说，当他们更具成长……

that is to say.note: 唯一一句被截断，例句保持原样

example.en: Improved technology gives birth to highly popular products.
example.zh: 技术进步催生出广受欢迎的产品。

example.en: It turns out that ASMR is pretty special.
example.zh: 结果发现ASMR相当特别。

turn out.note: 含 turn out to be / it turns out (that)

bring sth to life.zh: 使生动起来，使变得真实

example.en: Design Ventura, which helps to bring the standard curriculum to life
example.zh: Design Ventura 有助于让标准课程生动起来

bring sth to life.note: 例句截取了原句中间一段

bring sth up to date.zh: 使……更新，使符合最新情况

example.en: Bring policies against cheating up to date.
example.zh: 更新反作弊的政策。

to one's advantage.zh: 对某人有利，利用……为己所用

example.en: Why not use it to your advantage?
example.zh: 为什么不好好利用它呢？

to one's advantage.note: 例句截取了原句后半；use sth to one's advantage 才是常见搭配

example.en: More people have taken to bottled water because of their health awareness.
example.zh: 出于健康意识，更多人开始喝瓶装水了。

example.en: We can never be truly free if taking to heart others’ opinion of us.
example.zh: 如果总把别人对我们的看法放在心上，我们永远无法真正自由。

take sth to heart.note: 真题里宾语后置：take to heart sth

example.en: It runs counter to the public interest.

out of office.zh: （Out of Office 邮件生成器）外出，不在办公室

example.en: Why did the author and his colleagues launch the Out of Office Email Generator?
example.zh: 为什么作者和同事推出了“外出邮件生成器”？

out of office.note: 两句都是产品名 Out of Office Email Generator，不是在讲短语本义，建议作废（或仅在日后单独出现 out of office 时再收）

example.en: It provides refugees with a wide range of courses free of charge.
example.zh: 它免费向难民提供大量课程。

example.en: attitude, but those who aren't as genetically gifted aren't necessarily out of luck.
example.zh: 那些遗传上没那么有天赋的人不一定就没希望。

example.en: Not to think highly of her qualifications when promoted or given a pay raise.
example.zh: 升职或加薪时不看重她的资历。

example.en: We should stay persistent even in face of failures.
example.zh: 即使面对失败，我们也应该坚持。

in face of.note: 原写法 in face of 为缺 the 的写法，规范为 in the face of；此句也常见 in face of

example.en: More and more people are treating pet cats like their children.
example.zh: 越来越多的人把宠物猫当孩子对待。

more and more.note: 形容词/副词比较级重复式，另 less and less 同类

example.en: What does he do to strengthen his muscles and all that?
example.zh: 他做什么来增强肌肉之类的？

example.en: We consider some clothes to be powerful some to be fun, and so on.
example.zh: 我们认为有些衣服显得有力量，有些显得有趣，等等。

example.en: At my well-respected, private, four-year university in Washington, D.C., which boasts a yearly tuition of $44,046 not including room and board, I receive over $57,000 yearly in financial aid.
example.zh: 我就读于华盛顿特区一所声誉很好的四年制私立大学，年学费高达44046美元（不含食宿），而我每年得到超过57000美元的助学金。

example.en: They are less and less indifferent to it.
example.zh: 他们对此越来越不冷漠了。

less and less.note: 句1中 less and less of a presence 为名词性用法（越来越少的存在感）

example.en: better habits day-in and day-out, continual progress will be the logical outcome.
example.zh: 如果天天养成更好的习惯，持续的进步就是必然结果。

day in and day out.note: 连字符写法 day-in and day-out 已并入；两句都是片段

example.en: I’ve read some financial education books, done some online learning, and have spoken to my nearest and dearest for
example.zh: 我读过一些理财书，做过一些线上学习，还和我的亲人们聊过。

one's nearest and dearest.note: 原句被截断，结尾不完整

example.en: the terms and conditions that require agreement when using new software products.
example.zh: 使用新软件产品时需要同意的条款和条件。

example.en: Talking on and on about what’s interesting to you isn’t going to make you an interesting person, she says.
example.zh: 她说，不停地谈论你感兴趣的事并不会让你成为有趣的人。

example.en: Today, a greater and greater proportion of people living on the streets are there because of bad luck or a series of mistakes, or because the economy forgot them—they lost a job or were evicted or fled an abusive marriage just as the housing market was growing increasingly unforgiving.
example.zh: 如今，越来越多的街头流浪者是因为运气不好或一连串失误。

greater and greater.note: 只是「比较级 and 比较级」的普通重复结构（同 bigger and bigger），非固定短语；如需保留可统一并入「比较级 and 比较级」

example.en: The schools don’t have to pay anything to take part in the Design Ventura competition.
example.zh: 学校参加 Design Ventura 比赛不需要付任何费用。

example.en: But the bike lanes were a done deal, and soon they were in place.
example.zh: 但自行车道已成定局，很快就建好了。

in place.note: 句0/1 为同一句被拆开

example.en: The findings show: in principle, most people view it more ___28___ when workers are replaced by other people than by
example.zh: 研究结果显示：原则上，大多数人认为用其他人取代工人时更……（空格）

in principle.note: 唯一例句是完形填空，含空格 ___28___ 且句子被截断；建议人工换句

example.en: In truth, natural flavors do not _28_ much, at least chemically speaking, from their flavor-boosting _29_: artificial flavors.
example.zh: 说实话，天然香料与其增味的……人工香料，在化学上并没有太大区别。

in addition.zh: 此外；另外（in addition to 意为除…之外）

example.en: In addition to tuition, college students have to pay extra fees for the courses they take.
example.zh: 除了学费，大学生还要为所选课程额外付费。

in addition.note: 含 in addition 与 in addition to 两种用法，合并在一条

example.en: It brought in the most advanced instruments.
example.zh: 它引进了最先进的仪器。

bring in.note: 字面“带进来”与“引进”混用，整体按引申义收

example.en: In contrast, they felt less judged by members of their own group.
example.zh: 相比之下，他们感觉自己群体的成员对他们的评判较少。

example.en: In fact, we need blue light during the day to be healthy.
example.zh: 事实上，我们白天需要蓝光才能保持健康。

example.en: No injuries were reported in connection with the fire.
example.zh: 没有与这场火灾有关的人员受伤报告。

in connection with.note: 原句后接 [2] 另一句，已截取前半句

example.en: They could become a rare treat in the near future.
example.zh: 它们在不久的将来可能变成稀罕的享受。

example.en: He later handed them in to the Cologne police.
example.zh: 他后来把它们交给了科隆警方。

example.en: She didn’t sign up for membership in time.
example.zh: 她没有及时注册会员。

example.en: Decided on this year’s energy assistance package of $8 billion in total.
example.zh: 今年决定的能源援助方案总共80亿美元。

in total.note: 例句为省略主语的片段

example.en: They will find they have something in common.
example.zh: 他们会发现彼此有共同点。

example.en: The city’s council and ScottishPower have announced a range of strategies in an attempt to reduce carbon emissions ahead of the new national target of 2045.
example.zh: 市议会和苏格兰电力公司宣布了一系列策略，试图在2045年新国家目标之前减少碳排放。

example.en: In short, natural flavors are _32_ from plants and animals to create specific flavors for processed foods.
example.zh: 总之，天然香料是从植物和动物中……（空格）出来的，用来为加工食品创造特定风味。

example.en: A police spokeswoman said that officers were currently in attendance at the scene.
example.zh: 警方发言人说，警员目前已在现场。

example.en: Send in applications before Friday.
example.zh: 周五前把申请寄来。

come in.zh: 名列（第几）；（价格等）为；出现；到来

example.en: In the following two years, Red Rum lost out on the title, coming in second both times.
example.zh: 在接下来两年里，赤朗姆没能夺冠，两次都屈居第二。

come in.note: 4句含义分散（位次/价格/进来/出现），其中“带着钱进来”接近字面方向，整体仍保留；拿不准是否过杂

example.en: Begin seeing moving images and characters in action.
example.zh: 开始看到活动的影像和角色。

in action.note: 例句为去掉编号 “— 9” 的片段

example.en: When in the presence of an unknown student from their own university, only 12 per cent of students selected the healthier option.
example.zh: 当有来自本校的陌生学生在场时，只有12%的学生选择了更健康的选项。

in the presence of.note: 原句后接 [17] 另一句，已截取前半句

example.en: In particular, dangerous conditions such as icy roads or wet ground could cause difficulty for drivers.
example.zh: 尤其是结冰的道路或潮湿的地面等危险状况，可能给司机带来困难。

a slap in the face.zh: 当面打脸，侮辱；严重的冒犯

example.en: Not welcoming children under ten is a complete slap in the face to families.
example.zh: 不欢迎十岁以下的孩子，对家庭来说是彻头彻尾的侮辱。

example.en: In other words, we’re all really, really stressed.
example.zh: 换句话说，我们都压力很大。

example.en: In any case, it’s
example.zh: 无论如何，它是……

in any case.note: 唯一例句被截断，需人工确认；原卷 cet4_2025_12_2

example.en: Just make sure you’re logged in.
example.zh: 只要确保你已登录。

example.en: To them, a difference, no matter how small in your eyes, signals the end of the relationship.
example.zh: 对他们来说，无论在你眼中多么微小的差别，都标志着关系的结束。

in the eyes of.note: 例句为 in your eyes 变体；另一句 in the eyes of key observers 含完形空格

example.en: Do you have anything in mind?
example.zh: 你心里有什么想法吗？

in mind.note: 常见搭配 have sth in mind / bear in mind

example.en: Research by Amanda Lenhart of the Pew Research Centre, a US think tank, found that the most passionate texters are also the kids most likely to spend time with friends in person.
example.zh: 皮尤研究中心的阿曼达·伦哈特的研究发现，最热衷发短信的孩子也最可能当面和朋友相处。

example.en: It is not in fashion any more.
example.zh: 它已经不流行了。

example.en: Early on, the web is their “third space”, but by the late teens, it’s replaced in reaction to greater independence.
example.zh: 网络起初是他们的“第三空间”，但到了十几岁后期，它因为更大的独立性而被取代。

in reaction to.note: in + reaction + to 意思可由字面推出，是普通搭配，非固定短语；建议作废

example.en: But you can get 25% off if you sign up in advance.
example.zh: 但如果你提前报名，可以打七五折。

example.en: “It’s going to feel like a made-up conversation that people don’t necessarily want to tune in to.
example.zh: 这会让人觉得像是编造的对话，人们不一定想去收听。

example.en: Fraudsters also invest in pay-per-click advertising to feature at the top of search engines when people type in phrases such as “Spanish seaside villas”.
example.zh: 骗子还投放按点击付费的广告，让人们输入“西班牙海滨别墅”等词语时，自己的广告排在搜索结果顶部。

type in.note: type + in 接近字面方向，但 type in 在词典中作“输入”整体记忆，保留

example.en: This in turn helps us become better negotiators and abstract thinkers.
example.zh: 这反过来又帮助我们成为更好的谈判者和抽象思考者。

in turn.note: 句3 为 in turns（轮流/交替），与前三句略异

example.en: How those decreases will be felt will depend on the degree of warming and the crop in question, but in general, “anything over about 30°C is very bad for crops,” says Wolfram Schlenker, an associate professor of international and public affairs at Columbia University.
example.zh: 这些减产将如何体现，取决于升温幅度和所涉作物，但总的来说……

in question.note: 例句较长；与 in general 在同一句出现

example.en: compared to 3 percent for Queens in general.
example.zh: 而皇后区整体为3%。

in general.note: 句1 为“in general 对整体”用法；例句为片段

factor in.zh: 把…考虑进去，把…计算在内

example.en: Have you factored those in?
example.zh: 你把这些都考虑进去了吗？

example.en: In essence, each driver would constantly make adjustments to keep their car roughly halfway
example.zh: 从本质上说，每位司机都会不断调整，让自己的车保持在大约中间的位置。

example.en: “Fathers may fare better than mothers in part due to how they spend time with their children,” said lead author Katherine Nelson-Coffey.
example.zh: “父亲们比母亲们表现更好，部分是因为他们陪孩子的方式。”主要作者凯瑟琳·尼尔森-科菲说。

in part.note: 句0 被拆开，part 单独成行

example.en: Please bear in mind that the price includes moving all the furniture, and the whole task would take two days.
example.zh: 请记住，价格包括搬所有家具，整个工作需要两天。

bear in mind.note: 与 keep in mind 同义，各自单列

example.en: I can’t remember his name, but he’s written three books in all.
example.zh: 我记不起他的名字，但他一共写了三本书。

in all.note: 例句截取原句前半，去掉了星号书名部分

take in.zh: 吸收，摄入；理解，接收（信息）

example.en: I’m very much dependent on vision as a way of taking in information.
example.zh: 我非常依赖视觉来获取信息。

take in.note: 句1 为摄入热量，句0 为接收信息

example.en: A skilled backroom operator who speaks without a filter, Ecclestone said often that in his opinion, the sport was at its best when he was allowed to act as "a dictator.
example.zh: 一位说话毫无顾忌的幕后操盘手埃克莱斯顿常说，在他看来，这项运动在他能像“独裁者”一样行事时最好。

check in.zh: 登记入住；办理登机手续

example.en: Now, all I need is to photocopy your passports and then I can get you all checked in and show you to your rooms.
example.zh: 我现在只需要复印你们的护照，就可以帮你们办好入住并带你们去房间。

example.en: Do you prefer to fill out an application on the web, or to print it out and fill it in by hand and then post it back to us?
example.zh: 你喜欢在网上填写申请表，还是打印出来手写填好再寄给我们？

fill in.note: 句0 为“填补空白”，句1 为“填写”

a kick in the pants.zh: 当头一棒，催促（促人行动的刺激）

example.en: psychological boost, or the proverbial kick in the pants.
example.zh: 心理上的提振，或者说俗话讲的“当头一棒”。

example.en: I have now come to realize that being boring, in actuality, is not only about who you are as a person, but also how you present yourself.
example.zh: 我现在意识到，无趣实际上不仅关乎你是怎样的人，也关乎你如何展现自己。

example.en: Willpower and habits go hand in hand.
example.zh: 意志力和习惯是相辅相成的。

example.en: To help employees in need adapt to the new work environment.
example.zh: 帮助有需要的员工适应新的工作环境。

in need.note: 句0 实为 in need of，已在 in need of 条目；此条建议保留 those in need 类用法

example.en: The position was completely in line with my degree.
example.zh: 这个职位与我的专业完全对口。

in line with.note: 例句为原句中的一个分句（原句很长）

example.en: So he is insane to give in to her like that.
example.zh: 所以他竟然那样向她让步，真是疯了。

example.en: It is important to keep in mind that personal space varies depending on culture and context.
example.zh: 重要的是要记住，个人空间因文化和场合而异。

keep in mind.note: 与 bear in mind 同义，各自单列

example.en: Fall in love with boredom and focus
example.zh: 爱上无聊，专注当下。

example.en: In that case, then.
example.zh: 那样的话，那就这样吧。

example.en: In reality, education does an aging brain good.
example.zh: 实际上，教育对衰老的大脑有益。

in reality.note: 句0、3 为同一句被拆开

in the business of.zh: 从事…行业；以…为业，致力于

example.en: Universities today are in the business of making money, and mine is no exception.
example.zh: 如今的大学是在做赚钱的生意，我所在的大学也不例外。

in the business of.note: 常以 be in the business of doing 的形式出现

blend in with.zh: 与…融为一体，与…混在一起而不显眼

example.en: There’s also a theory that this color helps the dolphins more readily blend in with their surroundings.
example.zh: 还有一种说法是，这种颜色能帮助海豚更好地融入周围环境。

in comparison.zh: 相比之下；（in comparison with）与…相比

example.en: In comparison, 17% of men said their job satisfaction went down and 20% said it went up.
example.zh: 相比之下，17%的男性说他们的工作满意度下降了，20%的说上升了。

example.en: The fact that we have been open and in business for all these years proves that.
example.zh: 我们这些年一直营业，这一事实就证明了这一点。

example.en: This is done in hopes of reducing the enormous amount of plastic pollution in the oceans.
example.zh: 这样做是希望减少海洋中大量的塑料污染。

example.en: In the second part of the study I found 76% of employees using social media for work took an interest in other organizations they found on social media.
example.zh: 在研究的第二部分，我发现76%用社交媒体工作的员工，对自己在社交媒体上发现的其他组织产生了兴趣。

example.en: when the city removed nearby parking to put in a bike lane.
example.zh: 当市里拆掉附近的停车位来修一条自行车道时。

put in.note: 例句为截断句；id1/2 是被切开的同一句（投入时间）

example.en: Big advances in speech recognition technology have enabled communication tools to turn live speech into text in real time on your smartphone or laptop, and sign language into text as well.
example.zh: 语音识别技术的巨大进步，使沟通工具能在你的智能手机或笔记本电脑上把现场讲话实时转成文字，也能把手语转成文字。

in order.zh: 井然有序，整齐；（证件等）符合规定

example.en: First, large houses take time to maintain, so cleaners and other low-wage service workers are required to keep these houses in order.
example.zh: 首先，大房子需要花时间维护，所以需要清洁工和其他低薪服务人员来保持这些房子整洁有序。

in order.note: 与 in order to（为了）不是同一条

example.en: It may make people feel that they ought to fit in with the outside world.
example.zh: 这可能让人觉得自己应该融入外面的世界。

example.en: The whole village chips in to help, including the kids, who end up developing their baking skills at an early age.
example.zh: 整个村子都来帮忙，包括孩子们，他们最后从小就练出了烘焙的本事。

stand in one's way.zh: 妨碍某人，挡住某人的路

example.en: of self-awareness and regularly took steps to adjust the things standing in their way to work-life balance.
example.zh: 并定期采取措施调整那些妨碍他们实现工作与生活平衡的因素。

example.en: Fruit juice is different from whole fruit in that it contains much less fibre.
example.zh: 果汁和整个水果的不同在于，它含的纤维少得多。

believe in.zh: 相信…的存在；信任，信奉；赞成

example.en: Chetan-Walsh believes in a ban on single-use bottles.
example.zh: Chetan-Walsh 赞成禁止一次性瓶子。

believe in.note: 介词固定搭配，但意思有引申，保留

example.en: through day-to-day, make sure your present self knows what's in it for her too.
example.zh: 在日常忙碌中，要让现在的自己知道，这对她也有好处。

what's in it for sb.note: 整句习语，pos 取 phr.（非标准列表）

example.en: the 11th year in a row.
example.zh: 连续第11年。

example.en: Second, after identifying the cause, they zeroed in on their
example.zh: 其次，找出原因之后，他们把注意力集中在自己的……上

check in with.zh: 与…联系，向…汇报情况；（check in with yourself）自我检视

example.en: Going through the steps, and constantly checking in with yourself
example.zh: 按步骤做，并不断自我检视

example.en: By keeping their emotions in check to avoid making poor decisions.
example.zh: 通过控制住自己的情绪，以避免做出糟糕的决定。

example.en: There is no point in transferring office work to working from home.
example.zh: 把办公室工作转到在家办公是没有意义的。

example.en: If meatless meat can help you stick to a plant-based diet, that in itself can lead to better health.
example.zh: 如果人造肉能帮你坚持植物性饮食，那本身就可能带来更好的健康。

example.en: It only means that the gender gap disappears when we plug in the negative reciprocity variable.
example.zh: 这只意味着，当我们把负面互惠变量代入模型时，性别差距就消失了。

plug in.note: 此处是统计中的‘代入’，非插电

example.en: Men can show friendship in public through physical affection.
example.zh: 男性可以在公共场合通过肢体亲昵来表达友情。

example.en: you attempt to make toward it on a personal level will be in vain.
example.zh: 你为此在个人层面做出的任何尝试都将是徒劳的。

example.en: More people will be willing to join in the effort.
example.zh: 更多人会愿意参与这项努力。

in conjunction with.zh: 与…一起，与…协同；（in conjunction）结合起来

example.en: They work in conjunction with the environment.
example.zh: 它们与环境协同作用。

in conjunction with.note: 也有不带 with 的 in conjunction（id0、2）

example.en: In order to sustain those relationships, you must be able to work in their best interests as well.
example.zh: 为了维持这些关系，你也必须能为他们的最大利益而工作。

in sb's best interests.note: id0 为 to the best interest of，单数写法，合并到此

in the least.zh: 丝毫，一点也（多用于否定句）

example.en: The art of telling a story using music has not faded in the least
example.zh: 用音乐讲故事的艺术丝毫没有衰退

example.en: The idea is for people to get back in touch with the soil — while
example.zh: 这个想法是让人们重新接触土壤

in touch.note: get back in touch with = 重新接触/恢复联系

in perspective.zh: 客观地看待，正确地权衡

example.en: students keep their ongoing academic or social difficulties in perspective.
example.zh: 学生们能客观看待自己持续存在的学业或社交困难。

example.en: The most recent count of pandas found that there were more than 1,800 left in the wild, putting them on the list of
example.zh: 最近一次统计发现，野外还剩下1800多只大熊猫，……

in the spotlight.zh: 受到公众关注，成为焦点

example.en: They placed the sugar industry in the spotlight with their new findings.
example.zh: 他们的新发现让糖业成为了公众关注的焦点。

make up.zh: 构成，占（比例）；弥补（时间）；编造

example.en: Those over 45 make up the bulk of the long-term
example.zh: 45岁以上的人占长期失业者的大部分

example.en: a research grant or just barely made it.
example.zh: 一笔科研经费，或者只是勉强做到了

example.en: "Take it slow and do it again.
example.zh: “慢慢来，再做一遍。

example.en: It was tourists not natives who were cleaning up the beach.
example.zh: 是游客，而不是当地人，在清理海滩。

example.en: I’ve been thinking it over, and I’d like to send him to Westwood Elementary.
example.zh: 我一直在考虑这件事，我想送他去威斯特伍德小学。

example.en: Explaining why she has kept up the videos, Andrea explained how nice it was to have a little bit of fun and craziness that made people smile.
example.zh: 解释自己为什么一直坚持发那些视频时，安德烈娅说，有一点乐趣和疯狂劲儿让人们微笑，是件很美好的事。

as ... as it gets.zh: 再…不过了，已经是最…的了

example.en: The body of KaiOS phones is as basic as it gets.
example.zh: KaiOS 手机的机身已经是再基础不过了。

as ... as it gets.note: 形如 as basic as it gets

take up.zh: 开始从事（爱好、活动）；占用（空间、时间）；接手，处理（问题）；担任（职位）

example.en: More and more people are taking up extreme sports, like snowboarding, skateboarding, mountain biking, and many more.
example.zh: 越来越多的人开始从事极限运动，比如单板滑雪、滑板、山地自行车等。

example.en: Figure out which of the two is more reliable.
example.zh: 搞清楚这两个中哪个更可靠。

example.en: That is, American inequality means that the gains of
example.zh: 也就是说，美国的不平等意味着……的收益

that is.note: 含 that is to say（id4）；例句为截断句

mind you.zh: 请注意，说真的（插入语，补充说明）

example.en: Nothing serious, mind you, but he damaged someone’s car and wanted to get some money together to make up for the damage he’d caused.
example.zh: 不过说真的，事情不严重，但他弄坏了别人的车，想凑点钱赔偿他造成的损失。

example.en: See you Thursday.
example.zh: 周四见。

see you.note: pos 取 int.；口语告别语

if you will.zh: 可以这么说，如果你愿意这么称呼的话

example.en: accessible fruit and vegetable gardens connect what we eat to where it comes from—the means of production, if you will.
example.zh: 可以这么说，容易获得的水果蔬菜园把我们吃的东西与它的来源——生产方式——联系起来。

example.en: I’ve never been to the head office, you know.
example.zh: 你知道的，我从没去过总部。

there you are.zh: 你在这儿啊；给你（递东西时）

example.en: There you are.
example.zh: 你在这儿啊。

there you are.note: 听力口语，上下文可能是‘找到你了’或‘给你’

be on good terms with.zh: 与…关系好；（on bad terms）关系不好

example.en: She was on bad terms with her neighbors.
example.zh: 她和邻居们关系不好。

be on good terms with.note: 变体 on better/bad terms 合并

example.en: If you’ve ever looked at the ingredients list while grocery shopping, chances are you’ve seen the term “natural flavors”.
example.zh: 如果你买菜时看过配料表，很可能见过“天然香料”这个词。

example.en: Some people find it “snobby” and others simply find it irritating because they have a hard time remembering which last name they are supposed to say first.
example.zh: 有些人觉得这很“势利”，还有些人只是觉得烦，因为他们很难记住应该先说哪个姓。

be supposed to.note: 例句已删括号内的中文注释

example.en: But now that she ran out of money, she can’t.
example.zh: 但既然她的钱花光了，她就不能了。

example.en: I’d also like it to be small, so that it’s easy to drive in the city.
example.zh: 我还想要它小一点，这样在城里开起来方便。

example.en: According to a research paper, drinking fruit juice is beneficial on condition that it is consumed in reasonable amounts.
example.zh: 根据一篇研究论文，只要适量饮用，喝果汁是有益的。

example.en: that teenagers will be able to take a natural history test given that for decades children have been able to name more video
example.zh: 青少年能够参加自然历史测验，因为几十年来孩子们……

example.en: That said, curiosity does have a genetic component.
example.zh: 话虽如此，好奇心确实有遗传成分。

example.en: For instance, they may drop difficult coursework.
example.zh: 例如，他们可能会放弃难的课程。

mistake sth for sth.zh: 把某物错当成某物，误认为

example.en: Women tend to mistake signs of heart attacks for symptoms of stress.
example.zh: 女性往往把心脏病发作的迹象误当作压力的症状。

example.en: Take smartphones for example.
example.zh: 以智能手机为例。

example.en: It seemed to make up for his physical defects.
example.zh: 这似乎弥补了他身体上的缺陷。

make up for.note: make up for 与 make up 分开统计

allow for.zh: 考虑到，顾及；使…成为可能

example.en: The toughness of the race allows for racers to eat pretty much whatever they want.
example.zh: 比赛的艰苦让参赛者几乎想吃什么就吃什么。

allow for.note: 例句为‘使可能/允许’义，id0 为‘考虑到’

example.en: So if you want to know for certain what you’re getting with your groceries, you might want to stick to the farmer’s market.
example.zh: 所以，如果你想确切知道买的食品里有什么，最好坚持去农贸市场。

account for.zh: 解释（原因）；占（比例）；考虑到

example.en: What accounted for the gender gap in airfares.
example.zh: 是什么造成了航班票价的性别差距。

account for.note: 例句是‘解释/造成’义，占比义见 id2

example.en: There will be crowds of people waiting for her.
example.zh: 会有一群人在等她。

wait for.note: 动词+介词的普通搭配，意思可直接推出，不是固定短语

example.en: To properly care for patients, we also need to care about the lives of the people getting the care.
example.zh: 为了好好照顾病人，我们还需要关心那些接受护理的人的生活。

example.en: A child deviates from social pressures when they stand up for another child being bullied in school.
example.zh: 当孩子为另一个被欺负的孩子挺身而出时，他会偏离社会压力。

example.en: It calls for due assistance.
example.zh: 这需要得当的帮助。

control for.zh: （统计中）控制变量，排除…的影响

example.en: In a research paper, Evil Genius, published in 2014, the behavioral scientists Francesca Gino and Scott Wiltermuth wanted to examine whether people who behave unethically in one task are more creative than others on a subsequent task, even after controlling for differences in baseline creative skills.
example.zh: 在一篇2014年发表的论文《邪恶天才》中，行为科学家弗朗西斯卡·吉诺和斯科特·威尔特穆斯想检验：在一项任务中行为不道德的人，是否在随后的任务中比别人更有创造力，即使在排除了基础创造力差异的影响之后。

control for.note: 唯一一句，很长；去掉了前面的字母编号 G)

example.en: I’m up for that.
example.zh: 我愿意。

example.en: For now, the jury is still out as to how successful those endeavours will be.
example.zh: 目前，这些努力能有多成功还不好说。

example.en: She didn’t sign up for membership in time.
example.zh: 她没有及时报名成为会员。

example.en: Don’t go for a colour because it’s in fashion, or you’ve seen it in a magazine.
example.zh: 不要因为一种颜色流行，或者你在杂志上见过，就选它。

example.en: "In a way," she said, the rooster "stands for 'We The People.'"
example.zh: “在某种意义上，”她说，这只公鸡代表“我们人民”。

example.en: We were thinking of renting a car, but we will explore all the options available for sure.
example.zh: 我们本来想租辆车，但我们一定会把所有可选方案都看一遍。

for sure.note: 去掉了后面带方括号的句子

example.en: The platform will allow refugees worldwide to take thousands of online courses for free.
example.zh: 这个平台将让全世界的难民免费学习数千门在线课程。

example.en: Imagine boating down the Amazon River, minding your own business—calmly keeping an eye out for alarmingly large snakes—and a curious pink dolphin appears to swim alongside.
example.zh: 想象你在亚马孙河上划船，不管闲事，平静地留意着特别大的蛇，这时一只好奇的粉红海豚游到你身边。

keep an eye out for.note: 去掉了后面带方括号的句子

example.en: Makers of clear plastic bottles may also opt for new fossil-fuel based plastic to save money.
example.zh: 透明塑料瓶的制造商也可能为了省钱而选择新的化石燃料塑料。

pound for pound.zh: 按重量计算，同等重量下

example.en: For example, pound for pound, beef requires 15 times more feed to raise than carp, a freshwater fish farmed all over Asia.
example.zh: 例如，同等重量下，养牛所需的饲料是养鲤鱼的15倍，鲤鱼是一种在亚洲各地养殖的淡水鱼。

example.en: product is going on sale for real and the boys had to learn about budgeting and marketing, as well as designing their game.
example.zh: 产品真的要上市销售了，男孩们不得不学习预算和营销，以及设计他们的游戏。

for real.note: id0 是 for real success（形容 success），不是该短语，标注有误一条

example.en: We were assured that, except for low grades or a raise in family income, no money would be taken away.
example.zh: 我们得到保证，除了成绩低或家庭收入增加之外，不会取消任何资助。

example.en: At the Dreamery, a business in Manhattan, naps are for sale.
example.zh: 在曼哈顿的一家企业 Dreamery，小睡是出售的服务。

example.en: For starters, Americans eat much bigger portions than people in other countries.
example.zh: 首先，美国人吃的份量比其他国家的人大得多。

for one's own good.zh: 对自己不利地（too…for one's own good：太…以致反受其害）；为了自己好

example.en: The findings suggest that some people may be too emotionally clever for their own good, says Bechtoldt.
example.zh: 贝希托尔特说，研究结果表明，有些人情商太高，反而对自己不利。

for one's own good.note: 真题里是 too ... for one's own good（过于…以致自己吃亏）；字面义「为了某人好」也可记

for one.zh: 首先，其一（列举理由时，常与 for another 连用）

example.en: For one, starting on a new career path is not as simple as watching a few videos and obtaining an online certificate.
example.zh: 首先，开启新的职业道路并不像看几个视频、拿一个在线证书那么简单。

for one.note: 例句末尾后半句已删去以求简短；与 for another 成对使用

for another.zh: 其二，另外（列举理由时，接在 for one 之后）

example.en: For another, most of the classes on Coursera are in English, and though there are plans to add translations, language barriers can be a big obstacle.
example.zh: 其次，Coursera 上的大多数课程是英文的，尽管有增加翻译的计划，语言障碍仍可能是个大障碍。

for another.note: 与 for one 成对使用，也可考虑合并为「for one ... for another」

put on.zh: 穿上，戴上；拉上，装上（如手刹）

example.en: Now comes the part when you put on your detective hat and do a little digging.
example.zh: 现在到了你戴上侦探帽、稍微深入挖掘一下的环节。

example.en: It found a pet dog on board a plane to a city in Texas.
example.zh: 它在一架飞往得克萨斯州某城市的飞机上发现了一只宠物狗。

work on.zh: 从事，致力于；研究，处理；修理

example.en: He was working on a study project with Jimmy.
example.zh: 他正和吉米一起做一个学习项目。

call on.zh: 点名（让某人发言）；号召，呼吁；拜访

example.en: They may feel helpless when called on by the instructor.
example.zh: 被老师点名时，他们可能会感到无助。

example.en: Over 4,000 pipers and drummers are expected to descend on the city for the annual event.
example.zh: 预计将有 4000 多名风笛手和鼓手涌入这座城市参加一年一度的盛会。

example.en: It is ninety grams daily on average.
example.zh: 平均每天九十克。

example.en: He is not yet mature enough to live on his own.
example.zh: 他还不够成熟，不能独立生活。

example.en: She stated that the driver of the lorry had been arrested on suspicion of dangerous driving.
example.zh: 她说这辆卡车的司机因涉嫌危险驾驶被逮捕了。

example.en: It's a shame you missed out on the general discount.
example.zh: 你错过了普通折扣，真可惜。

example.en: Look back on their years at school.
example.zh: 回顾他们的学生时代。

take on.zh: 承担，接下（任务、责任）；呈现（特征）；采用

example.en: It's best to take on the most difficult task second—once they're settled, but before they get tired.
example.zh: 最好把最难的任务排在第二个——等他们安顿下来之后、疲劳之前。

go on.zh: 发生，进行；继续；接着（做）（go on to do）

example.en: A long-standing debate is going on over the impact of school absences on students' academic performance.
example.zh: 关于缺课对学生学业表现的影响，一场长期的争论仍在进行。

example.en: This might present problems for young people later on.
example.zh: 这可能会在以后给年轻人带来问题。

catch up on.zh: 补上（落下的事）；了解最新情况

example.en: I've been catching up on some reading.
example.zh: 我一直在补一些阅读。

example.en: Indeed, as they get older and are given more freedom, they often ease up on social networking.
example.zh: 确实，随着年龄增长、获得更多自由，他们常常会减少社交网络的使用。

example.en: Teachers are also losing their snow days and instead will be expected to be on hand to take a virtual register and
example.zh: 教师们的雪天假也没有了，而是要随时在线做虚拟点名，并且

stay on.zh: 继续留下，继续留任；留在原处

example.en: But among those who stayed on, the close losers performed even better
example.zh: 但在留下来的人当中，险些落败者表现得更好。

stay on.note: 原句缺句号，已不影响理解

example.en: I tried logging on to the website and couldn't, she recalls.
example.zh: 她回忆说：“我试着登录那个网站，但登不上。”

example.en: Early on, the web is their “third space”, but by the late teens, it’s replaced in reaction to greater independence.
example.zh: 早期，网络是他们的“第三空间”，但到了十几岁后期，随着更加独立，它就被取代了。

example.en: Remind people to cut down on snacking.
example.zh: 提醒人们少吃零食。

example.en: They are a shade of red bordering on brown.
example.zh: 它们是一种近乎棕色的红色。

example.en: On paper, my expenses and my financial aid just about even out.
example.zh: 从账面上看，我的开销和助学金基本持平。

on paper.note: 第一句 Off paper 是对比用法，意思是「不在纸面上」

example.en: And these attachment styles carry on into adulthood.
example.zh: 而且这些依恋类型会延续到成年期。

on the way.zh: 在途中，在…路上；即将到来；正走向（on the way to）

example.en: There’s that American style diner on the way to the mall.
example.zh: 去商场的路上有那家美式餐馆。

on the way.note: 近乎字面义（路上），拿不准是否算固定短语，作为常用搭配保留；on one's way 已并入

example.en: Oh, come on.
example.zh: 哦，得了吧。

come out on top.zh: 获胜，居于首位，成为赢家

example.en: persevering losers still came out on top.
example.zh: 坚持不懈的落败者仍然最终胜出。

example.en: What is that roadside monument I see on my way to work every day?
example.zh: 我每天上班路上看到的那座路边纪念碑是什么？

on one's way.note: 与 on the way 同属一个短语（on the way to = on one's way to），合并到 on the way

example.en: And it’s true; turning down opportunities is easier when you can fall back on the safety net provided by power, money, and authority.
example.zh: 确实如此；当你能依靠权力、金钱和权威提供的安全网时，拒绝机会会更容易。

example.en: "You need to pass on the traditions and the culture, and this is a part of our culture," he said.
example.zh: 他说：“你们需要把传统和文化传承下去，这也是我们文化的一部分。”

shed light on.zh: 阐明，使…得到解释，为…提供线索

example.en: It has shed light on teens’ instinct for rebellion and autonomy.
example.zh: 它揭示了青少年追求叛逆和自主的本能。

example.en: turn this pretty much on its head.
example.zh: 几乎把这一点彻底颠覆。

example.en: In the following two years, Red Rum lost out on the title, coming in second both times.
example.zh: 在接下来的两年里，红朗姆都与冠军失之交臂，两次都获得第二名。

build on.zh: 在…的基础上发展，以…为基础

example.en: Building on these findings, the latest research examined how a growth mindset of interest can boost integrative thinking across the traditional disciplinary boundaries of arts and sciences.
example.zh: 在这些发现的基础上，最新研究考察了兴趣上的成长型思维如何促进跨越传统文理学科界限的综合思维。

example.en: preparatory coursework are very unlikely to graduate on time and go on to get jobs.
example.zh: 预备课程……很不可能按时毕业并接着找到工作。

on time.note: 原句被截断；on time = 准时，学习者宜整体记

example.en: This allows managers to both keep an eye on struggling employees and provide ongoing feedback on how employees are adapting to their new work environment.
example.zh: 这让管理者既能留意那些吃力的员工，又能就员工适应新工作环境的情况持续给予反馈。

keep an eye on.note: 另一句用的是 keep a watchful eye on（变体）

draw on.zh: 利用，借鉴，动用（经验、知识等）

example.en: Draw on a vast wealth of past experience.
example.zh: 借鉴大量过往经验。

keep the lights on.zh: 维持运转，勉强维持经营

example.en: For organizations that have struggled to keep the lights on due to the pandemic, this might mean thinking of non-financial ways to reward employees, like unpaid time off or flexible work schedules.
example.zh: 对于因疫情而勉强维持运转的机构来说，这可能意味着要想出非金钱的方式来奖励员工，比如无薪休假或弹性工作安排。

example.en: To improve on traditional organizational structures
example.zh: 改进传统的组织结构

improve on.note: improve + on 属于动词固定搭配，on 只引出对象，意思就是 improve（改进）；按动词义项标即可，不当作短语

example.en: Compared with those findings, these numbers were shocking to me.
example.zh: 与那些发现相比，这些数字令我震惊。

compared with.note: 部分句子（如 compared teacher ... with ...）只是 compare...with 的普通用法，不是该短语

charge sb with sth.zh: 指控，控告某人（罪名）；使充满（情感），赋予；让某人负责（be charged with）

example.en: She was charged with mistreating animals.
example.zh: 她被控虐待动物。

charge sb with sth.note: 真题里有三种意思：指控（最多）、be charged with emotion/meaning 充满、be charged with doing 负责

example.en: It may be because your brains operate in harmony with each other.
example.zh: 这可能是因为你们的大脑彼此协调运作。

example.en: And whatever their financial background, or their educational background, most people will have something in common with each other.
example.zh: 无论经济背景还是教育背景如何，大多数人彼此都会有些共同之处。

have sth in common with.note: 并入 have sth in common（with 引出对象）

example.en: Make friends with Jimmy.
example.zh: 和吉米交朋友。

example.en: It should provide students with some basic knowledge.
example.zh: 它应该给学生提供一些基础知识。

example.en: "They came up with this," he says.
example.zh: 他说：“是他们想出来的。”

example.en: But generally speaking, soft cheeses are creamy and go well with sweet things like honey and jam.
example.zh: 但总的来说，软奶酪口感绵滑，与蜂蜜、果酱这类甜味食物很搭。

go well with.note: 也可视为 go with（搭配）加副词 well，但 go well with 常整体记，保留

example.en: Watch the series together with the woman.
example.zh: 和那位女士一起看这部剧。

stick with.zh: 坚持（使用、做），继续做；不离开

example.en: We love to establish a routine and stick with it.
example.zh: 我们喜欢建立一套常规并坚持下去。

go with.zh: 伴随，随之而来；与…相配；选择，接受

example.en: If serious reading dies, a lot will go with it.
example.zh: 如果严肃阅读消亡，许多东西也会随之消失。

example.en: Emotional intelligence helps people get along with others.
example.zh: 情商帮助人们与他人相处。

example.en: Nobody can really be sure if risks will be met with success, no matter how calculated they may be.
example.zh: 无论风险经过多么周密的计算，没有人能真正确定它们是否会成功。

be met with.note: be met with success 的 met with 为被动式，意思为「得到/遇到」

example.en: This theory guesses that after developing sign languages, people eventually started making sounds along with their gestures.
example.zh: 这一理论推测，在发展出手语之后，人们最终开始在做手势的同时发出声音。

come away with.zh: 带着（印象、收获）离开；获得

example.en: Pasternak also came away with some valuable observations about how different the North American way of life was, compared with many other countries.
example.zh: 帕斯捷尔纳克也得出了一些有价值的观察，了解到北美的生活方式与许多其他国家相比有多么不同。

example.en: She has walked too many miles in the halls of hospitals visiting too many far-gone patients and seeing too many medical mistakes to go along with conventional thinking.
example.zh: 她在医院走廊里走了太多路，探视过太多病入膏肓的病人，见过太多医疗失误，因此无法认同传统的思维。

example.en: The idea is for people to get back in touch with the soil
example.zh: 这个想法是让人们重新亲近土壤

get in touch with.note: 原句被截断；真题里是 get back in touch with（重新接触）

example.en: Funding for science has changed with the times.
example.zh: 科学经费随着时代而变化。

keep up with.zh: 跟上，赶上；了解最新情况

example.en: They feel pressured to keep up with female colleagues.
example.zh: 他们感到有压力，要跟上女同事。

example.en: It has done away with many of the traditional ways of thinking.
example.zh: 它已经摒弃了许多传统的思维方式。

example.en: The words “yes” and “no” get so often used in comparison with each other that it feels like they carry equal weight in conversation.
example.zh: “是”和“不”经常被相互比较着使用，感觉它们在对话中分量相当。

in comparison with.note: 意思与 compared with 相同，但写法不同，不合并

with open arms.zh: 张开双臂，热烈地（欢迎、接受）

example.en: Embrace it with open arms.
example.zh: 张开双臂拥抱它。

example.en: Research has found the use of digital technology benefits not only teenagers’ social lives but also their studies.
example.zh: 研究发现，使用数字技术不仅有益于青少年的社交生活，也有益于他们的学习。

not only...but also.note: 含 not just...but also、not only...but 等变体写法，视为同一结构

example.en: He no longer has to worry about whether or not he can understand.
example.zh: 他不用再担心自己能不能听懂了。

whether or not.note: 部分句子是 whether...or not 拆开的形式，视为同一结构

if not.zh: 即使不是…也（至少）；如果不

example.en: If you have too much ambition, you'll find this hard, if not impossible.
example.zh: 如果你野心太大，你会觉得这很难，即便不是不可能的话。

if not.note: 真题用法是插入语 hard, if not impossible（即使不是…也…）

example.en: It is not in fashion any more.
example.zh: 它不再流行了。

not any more.note: 拿不准：基本是 not + any more 的组合，与 no longer 同义，保留作常见搭配

why not.zh: 为什么不（提出建议）；为什么不呢

example.en: Why not just pay with your phone?
example.zh: 为什么不直接用手机付款呢？

not really.zh: 不太，并不真的；其实不是（委婉否定）

example.en: Not really.
example.zh: 不见得。/并不是。

not really.note: 拿不准：字面可推出，但口语应答时整体记更有用

not at all.zh: 一点也不，根本不；（回应感谢）不客气

example.en: No, not at all.
example.zh: 不，一点也不。

example.en: The new parents have yet to name the sixth baby but are considering either Lily or Rose.
example.zh: 这对新晋父母还没给第六个孩子起名，不过在考虑叫莉莉或罗斯。

example.en: Do you have anything in mind?
example.zh: 你心里有什么想法吗？

example.en: Their chances of finding new mates have a lot to do with their habitat.
example.zh: 它们找到新配偶的机会与其栖息地大有关系。

example.en: What do people in most healthy eating cultures have in common?
example.zh: 大多数健康饮食文化中的人有什么共同点？

play one's part.zh: 尽自己的一份力，发挥作用

example.en: Reaching our goals will need exactly this kind of partnership approach—with government, business, local authorities and citizens all playing their part.
example.zh: 实现我们的目标正需要这种合作模式——政府、企业、地方当局和公民都尽自己的一份力。

example.en: Over the years, other creatures like frogs and fish have found their way into toilets.
example.zh: 多年来，青蛙和鱼之类的其他生物也曾设法进入马桶。

example.en: So how can you help your child do their best?
example.zh: 那么，你怎样才能帮助孩子尽力而为呢？

example.en: On a recent Friday evening, the teenagers made their way across the studio floor as they practiced Chinese lion dancing.
example.zh: 最近的一个周五晚上，青少年们一边练习中国舞狮，一边走过工作室的地板。

mind one's own business.zh: 管好自己的事，不多管闲事

example.en: They usually mind their own business.
example.zh: 他们通常不管别人的闲事。

come one's way.zh: 降临到某人身上，落到某人头上

example.en: Deciding not to take on every project that comes their way.
example.zh: 决定不接手落到自己头上的每一个项目。

come one's way.note: 原句被截断，已去掉开头残片

example.en: They have been roused against their will.
example.zh: 他们被强行唤醒了。

example.en: To be fair to the German supermarkets.
example.zh: 对德国的超市公平地说。

example.en: Seventeen times per hour, to be exact.
example.zh: 确切地说，是每小时十七次。

more than.zh: 超过，多于；不仅仅，比…更（more than anything else）

example.en: It drew competitors from more than 40 countries.
example.zh: 它吸引了来自四十多个国家的参赛者。

more than.note: 多数句为「超过」，少数为「不仅仅/比…更」（句7、16、17）

example.en: The more calories, the better.
example.zh: 热量越多越好。

example.en: Spend no more than 30 dollars.
example.zh: 花费不要超过三十美元。

no more than.note: 绝大多数是作文题「不超过180词」

example.en: What's more, the 7,000 or so languages that exist today vary dramatically in how they utilize numbers.
example.zh: 而且，如今存在的约七千种语言在使用数字的方式上差异极大。

example.en: What we call multitasking, therefore, is in reality the ability to move more or less quickly from one task to another.
example.zh: 因此，我们所说的多任务处理，实际上是在不同任务之间或多或少快速切换的能力。

more or less.note: 句1中 more or less quickly 是「或多或少」；句0 more or less evenly 为「大致」

as long as.zh: 只要；既然…就；（时间）长达，只要…的时候

example.en: As long as there have been homework assignments and tests, there have been cheaters.
example.zh: 只要有作业和考试，就有作弊的人。

example.en: Correct their mistake as soon as possible.
example.zh: 尽快纠正他们的错误。

as soon as possible.note: 可视为 as soon as 的扩展，保留独立条目

example.en: Words considered to be concrete could be easily visualized such as “table” or “chair”.
example.zh: 被认为具体的词很容易在脑中想象出来，比如“桌子”或“椅子”。

example.en: With those born with natural talents, it feels as if they excel without really trying.
example.zh: 对于天生有才能的人，感觉他们不用真正努力就能出类拔萃。

come as a surprise.zh: 令人惊讶，出乎意料（to sb）

example.en: Its finding came as a surprise to the researchers.
example.zh: 它的发现让研究人员感到意外。

come as a surprise.note: 整体含义可由字面推出，但作为固定搭配（come as a surprise / no surprise）值得整体记；偏弱

example.en: Have meals as usual to stay away from hunger.
example.zh: 照常吃饭，以免饥饿。

example.en: It may lead to bad as well as good habits.
example.zh: 它可能导致坏习惯，也可能导致好习惯。

example.en: They are dealing with the same challenges that adults are, as far as they are living in a tech environment designed to suck as much of their time onto their devices as possible.
example.zh: 他们面对的挑战和成年人一样，因为他们同样生活在一个设计来尽可能占用他们设备时间的科技环境里。

as far as.note: 原句 as far as 用法特殊（近似 insofar as），例句删去了 OCR 空格；仅 1 句，建议复核

example.en: Research found that, as regards achievement of one’s goals, it is important to focus more on enjoying the process than the long-term benefits.
example.zh: 研究发现，就实现目标而言，更重要的是关注享受过程，而不是长远的好处。

as regards.note: 例句补全了被截断的结尾（取自原卷）

example.en: It was from 1855 and worth as much as $2,000.
example.zh: 它来自1855年，价值高达两千美元。

example.en: As many as 20 students show up after school.
example.zh: 放学后多达二十名学生到场。

example.en: As such, they’re more likely to be “let down” by the experience.
example.zh: 因此，他们更可能对这次经历感到“失望”。

as such.note: 此句 as such 为「因此」

example.en: Because when you are enjoying, people around you will begin to enjoy as well.
example.zh: 因为当你乐在其中时，你周围的人也会开始乐在其中。

example.en: I just got a credit card, so I thought I might as well buy a new phone.
example.zh: 我刚拿到一张信用卡，所以觉得不妨买部新手机。

example.en: As soon as two tasks require our attention, productivity suffers.
example.zh: 一旦两项任务同时需要我们的注意力，效率就会下降。

example.en: As ever, we ought to be careful about our own behaviour.
example.zh: 一如既往，我们应该留意自己的行为。

example.en: In the age of the internet, there’s no such thing as a private debate.
example.zh: 在互联网时代，不存在私下的辩论。

example.en: She suffered from lung cancer.
example.zh: 她患有肺癌。

suffer from.note: 动词 + 固定介词（同 rely on），按规则应在 suffer 的义项里处理，不作短语；如想保留作搭配可改回 true

example.en: But this is far from ideal.
example.zh: 但这远非理想。

apart from.zh: 除…之外（另有）；除…以外（不包括）

example.en: Joyce suggests that apart from self-care, women should seek professional support if they experience severe stress.
example.zh: 乔伊斯建议，除了自我照顾外，女性在承受严重压力时还应寻求专业帮助。

example.en: Aside from the link to type 2 diabetes, many studies agree that fruit juice is harmful if it contributes to an excess in calories.
example.zh: 除了与2型糖尿病的关联外，许多研究一致认为，如果果汁导致热量过剩，就是有害的。

aside from.note: 例句去掉了选项字母 E)

can't help but.zh: 不禁，忍不住（后接动词原形）

example.en: You can't help but be awed.
example.zh: 你不禁心生敬畏。

can't help but.note: 例句取自句1，删去了引号和后半句

example.en: An 81-year-old man ended up in Germany by accident after trying to get from Newcastle, Great Britain, to Rome, Italy.
example.zh: 一位81岁的男子本想从英国纽卡斯尔去意大利罗马，却意外到了德国。

by accident.note: 句0 实为 by chance（偶然），同义，已并入

by oneself.zh: 独自，单独；靠自己，独立地

example.en: Doing the painting job all by themselves.
example.zh: 全靠他们自己完成这项粉刷工作。

by oneself.note: 句0、1 的 by itself 是「本身；单靠」，用法略不同

example.en: What do you mean by blue light?
example.zh: 你说的蓝光是什么意思？

what do you mean by.note: 只是 mean by 的普通疑问句，每个词的意思相加即可推出，不算固定短语；学习者按 mean 的义项学即可

example.en: Do you prefer to fill out an application on the web, or to print it out and fill it in by hand and then post it back to us?
example.zh: 你喜欢在网上填写申请，还是打印出来手写后寄回给我们？

example.en: Alvin Chau, aged 26, is an environmental consultant by day and a lion dancer on weekends.
example.zh: 26岁的周亚文白天是环境顾问，周末是舞狮人。

by day.note: 偏透明，勉强保留；真题仅1句

example.en: They opened all of them one by one.
example.zh: 他们把它们一个一个全打开了。

example.en: By contrast, fossil fuel plastic was more expensive.
example.zh: 相比之下，化石燃料塑料更贵。

example.en: Setting up a spoken web is by no means an easy task.
example.zh: 建立口语网络绝非易事。

example.en: Le comes by the dance as a legacy.
example.zh: 乐从家族传承中得到了这门舞艺。

come by.note: 句子里是「继承而来」；字面不可推

example.en: Eyesight may dim and our recall may weaken, but by comparison, our ability to produce language is well preserved into older adulthood.
example.zh: 视力可能减退，记忆可能减弱，但相比之下，我们产出语言的能力到老年依然保持良好。

by comparison.note: 例句删去了被 OCR 空格破坏的 and understand 部分，仅作示意

example.en: Their wisdom grows as time goes by.
example.zh: 他们的智慧随着时间流逝而增长。

go by.note: 三种用法各 1 句：依据（句0）、流逝（句1）、以…名字称呼（句2）

by far.zh: …得多，到目前为止（与最高级连用）

example.en: It is also by far the world’s most expensive place to get sick.
example.zh: 它也是迄今为止世界上看病最贵的地方。

example.en: By all means, set ambitious long-term goals for your future self.
example.zh: 尽管为未来的自己设定雄心勃勃的长期目标吧。

by all means.note: 例句截取了 but 之前的分句

example.en: Stand by the parliament in fighting social diseases.
example.zh: 支持议会对抗社会弊病。

example.en: By making its voice heard, science can lead by example.
example.zh: 通过发出自己的声音，科学可以做出表率。

i mean.zh: 我是说，我的意思是（口语补充说明）

example.en: I mean, getting rid of rush hour may be impossible, but it could be made more tolerable, don’t you think?
example.zh: 我是说，要消除高峰时段也许不可能，但可以让它更容易忍受，你觉得呢？

i mean.note: 口语话语标记；偏长，句2 同样可选

example.en: What about a hard cheese?
example.zh: 硬奶酪怎么样？

example.en: What if an accident happens or you get ill and need medical treatment?
example.zh: 万一发生意外或你生病需要治疗怎么办？

guess what.zh: 你猜怎么着；猜猜看（引出新消息）

example.en: Guess what else?
example.zh: 你猜还有什么？

guess what.note: 真题仅2句，且都是口语开场；例句偏短但含义不如句1典型，仍选句0

no matter.zh: 无论，不管（后接 what / how / who 等）

example.en: Technology, no matter how advanced, should simply be a tool of a good teacher.
example.zh: 无论技术多么先进，它都应仅仅是好老师的工具。

example.en: It’s not just about being entertained, but also being inspired.
example.zh: 这不只关乎得到娱乐，也关乎得到启发。

not only ... but also.note: 含 not just ... but (also) 变体，已并入

example.en: The answers are anything but simple.
example.zh: 答案一点也不简单。

example.en: Children must read at least 3 times a week.
example.zh: 孩子们每周必须至少阅读三次。

at least.note: 大部分是作文题套话 at least 120 words

example.en: An operating system capable of doing several tasks at once.
example.zh: 一个能同时执行多项任务的操作系统。

at once.note: 真题多为「同时」，少数为「立刻」

at any cost.zh: 不惜任何代价，无论如何

example.en: Attempt to succeed at any cost.
example.zh: 不惜一切代价争取成功。

at any cost.note: 含 at all costs 变体

example.en: Give way to automobiles at all times.
example.zh: 任何时候都要给汽车让路。

example.en: At first, you just eliminate the obvious distractions and explore the rest.
example.zh: 起初，你只需排除明显的干扰，再去探索其余的。

at all.zh: 根本，完全（用于否定、疑问和条件句）

example.en: But that’s not what it means at all.
example.zh: 但那根本不是它的意思。

example.en: The sport was at its best when he was allowed to act as a dictator.
example.zh: 当他被允许像独裁者那样行事时，这项运动处于最佳状态。

at one's best.note: 例句取自长句，已去引号并简化为主句；仅 1 句

example.en: At any rate, what was lost now has been found, by many of the community’s littlest residents.
example.zh: 不管怎样，丢失的东西如今已被社区里许多最小的居民找到了。

at risk.zh: 处于危险中，有风险（at risk of 面临…风险）

example.en: New research suggests that pandas may be at risk of dying out because they are too comfortable.
example.zh: 新研究表明，大熊猫可能因为太安逸而面临灭绝的风险。

example.en: At last, the problem became so acute—and so visible—that Los Angeles took extraordinary action.
example.zh: 最后，问题变得如此严重、如此显眼，以至于洛杉矶采取了非常措施。

example.en: Attraction at first sight.
example.zh: 一见钟情的吸引。

example.en: The students themselves and society at large.
example.zh: 学生本人和整个社会。

at large.note: 例句由残句整理（首字母大写、去掉其后文字）

example.en: “This argument is, at best, far from sufficient,” he writes.
example.zh: 他写道：“这一论点充其量也远远不够充分。”

at best.note: 例句含引号，若网页处理引号不便可换

example.en: The problem then is you have to find accommodation at short notice.
example.zh: 那么问题就是你得临时找住处。

example.en: They do not make any sense at present.
example.zh: 它们目前毫无意义。

example.en: Supermarkets caused women to wander aisles bumping into boxes and picking things off shelves at random.
example.zh: 超市让女性在过道里游荡，碰到箱子，随手从货架上拿东西。

at random.note: 例句为改写缩短（原句更长且含括号），仅1句，建议复核

example.en: Pay either in cash or with his phone.
example.zh: 要么用现金支付，要么用他的手机支付。

example.en: It will come true sooner or later.
example.zh: 它迟早会实现。

or something.zh: 或者什么的（表示不确定）

example.en: And then, if you still wanted to give money as some sort of apology or something, he probably shouldn’t have to go around borrowing it from people.
example.zh: 然后，如果你还想拿钱当作某种道歉之类的，他大概不必四处向人借钱。

example.en: What's more, the 7,000 or so languages that exist today vary dramatically in how they utilize numbers.
example.zh: 而且，如今存在的七千种左右的语言在使用数字的方式上差异极大。

example.en: All of us can be affected by food instability one way or another.
example.zh: 我们所有人都可能以某种方式受到食物不稳定的影响。

example.en: As the night goes on, groups of riders are often seen traveling in just about every direction in the streets and on pedestrian paths.
example.zh: 随着夜幕降临，常常能看到成群骑行者几乎朝每个方向穿行在街道和人行道上。

just about.note: 句0 just about even out 也是「差不多」

example.en: Self-control only brings about small benefits.
example.zh: 自控只能带来小小的好处。

example.en: How about something healthy?
example.zh: 来点健康的东西怎么样？

example.en: The revolutionary idea of a self-service grocery first came about in America.
example.zh: 自助杂货店这一革命性的理念最早出现在美国。

come about.note: 例句删去了中间的修饰从句

example.en: He enjoys celebrating others’ birthdays rather than his own.
example.zh: 他喜欢庆祝别人的生日，而不是自己的。

example.en: It could be reshaped into animals other than rabbits.
example.zh: 它可以被重塑成兔子以外的动物。

example.en: His writing is more than a little dense — dense with research, clauses, and precise adjectives and nouns.
example.zh: 他的文章相当晦涩，充满了研究、从句和精确的形容词与名词。

example.en: In more than a few passages, she relates the stories of men and women who came up against assembly-line medicine where patients were treated mostly as pieces of flesh.
example.zh: 在不少段落中，她讲述了一些男女的经历，他们遭遇了流水线式的医疗，病人几乎被当作一块块肉来对待。

example.en: But it’s much easier said than done.
example.zh: 但这说起来容易做起来难。

wrap one's mind around.zh: 理解，弄懂（难以理解的事）

example.en: thinking about your deadline in terms of days rather than months or years can help you wrap your mind around how close the
example.zh: 用几天而不是几个月或几年来考虑截止日期，能帮你弄明白它有多近。

example.en: I personally feel sorry for the poor animals stuck in cages, but there’s no denying they are fun and educational for children.
example.zh: 我个人为关在笼子里的可怜动物感到难过，但不可否认，它们对孩子既有趣又有教育意义。

example.en: Help people connect with each other.
example.zh: 帮助人们彼此联系。

what's new.zh: 有什么新鲜事；近来怎么样（打招呼用语）

example.en: Recently, I was at a gathering of colleagues when someone turned to me and asked, “So, what’s new with you?
example.zh: 最近我在一次同事聚会上，有人转向我问道：“你最近怎么样？

example.en: Most of the time, though, the most popular compromise is to hyphenate your last name and the last name of your groom.
example.zh: 不过大多数时候，最常见的折中办法是把你的姓和新郎的姓用连字符连起来。

example.en: He was not of an age, but for all time.
example.zh: 他不只属于一个时代，而是属于千秋万代。

example.en: Many of us have an easier time identifying the things that we absolutely don’t want.
example.zh: 我们很多人更容易分辨出自己绝对不想要的东西。

have an easier time.note: have a hard time / have a good time 的比较级变体，each word 按 time（过程，经历）义项标即可；若要保留可视作 have a hard time 的反义用法，拿不准

take time off.zh: 休假，请假；抽出时间休息

example.en: Leaders should take time off themselves and encourage employees to do the same.
example.zh: 领导者自己应该休假，并鼓励员工也这样做。

example.en: Smart people also have a hard time accepting feedback.
example.zh: 聪明人也很难接受反馈。

have a hard time.note: 含 have a tough time 变体

example.en: Today, three decades after his retirement, he is still one of the best-known and most beloved racehorses of all time.
example.zh: 如今，他退役三十年后，仍是有史以来最著名、最受喜爱的赛马之一。

example.en: One is simply enjoying their time off work.
example.zh: 一种是单纯享受他们的下班休息时间。

example.en: Their wisdom grows as time goes by.
example.zh: 他们的智慧随时间增长。

example.en: I handle my own gold medal so gently that I would not scratch it.
example.zh: 我对待自己的金牌非常轻柔，以免刮伤它。

example.en: Even so, there have been a very small number of cases recently when authorities discovered eggs during further inspections.
example.zh: 即便如此，最近仍有极少数案例，当局在进一步检查中发现了虫卵。

example.en: So far, eight states and the District of Columbia have their own paid family leave laws.
example.zh: 到目前为止，已有八个州和哥伦比亚特区制定了自己的带薪家庭假法律。

example.en: Have a meal even if they have no money.
example.zh: 即使没有钱，也能吃上一顿饭。

example.en: If only I’d Googled before but I never thought of it.
example.zh: 要是我以前上网搜过就好了，可我从没想到过。

example.en: After all, it’s a good thing to know before actually accepting an offer.
example.zh: 毕竟，在真正接受录用前了解这些是件好事。

all right.zh: 好吧，行（表同意）；还不错，没问题

example.en: It looks all right.
example.zh: 看起来还不错。

example.en: Early zoos are found all over the world.
example.zh: 早期的动物园遍布世界各地。

example.en: It has beautiful weather all year round.
example.zh: 那里全年天气宜人。

example.en: It is filled with all kinds of video game characters.
example.zh: 里面到处都是各种电子游戏角色。

example.en: All things considered, I am paying significantly less than the ticket price of my university, and having an educational experience in Washington, D.C., that I would not have had anywhere else.
example.zh: 总的来说，我付的钱比我大学的学费低得多，却在华盛顿特区获得了别处得不到的教育经历。

all things considered.note: 含变体 all of this considered；例句较长，另一句被截断

at all costs.zh: 不惜一切代价，无论如何

example.en: This could be because some people want to avoid conflict at all costs, after all they still have to work together.
example.zh: 这可能是因为有些人想不惜一切代价避免冲突，毕竟他们还得一起工作。

example.en: Answer the questions by marking the corresponding letter on Answer Sheet 2.
example.zh: 在答题卡2上涂黑相应字母来回答问题。

answer sheet.note: 复合名词；全部出现在卷面答题说明里，无正文用法

example.en: For his part, Wang said that in his own experience, losing did light a motivating fire.
example.zh: 就他而言，王说根据他自己的经验，失败确实点燃了他奋进的火焰。

example.en: Try his best to persuade his wife.
example.zh: 尽力说服他的妻子。

try one's best.note: 例句是残缺的标题式短句

example.en: After combing through the security video outside a Gorbals shop, Kirsteen has now posted an image of a man suspected of stealing the dog.
example.zh: 在仔细查看了戈尔巴尔斯一家商店外的监控视频后，柯尔斯汀贴出了一张涉嫌偷狗男子的照片。

go through.zh: 经历，经受；仔细检查，逐一过一遍；办理（手续）

example.en: What Kelli Harding went through in Washington changed her life.
example.zh: 凯莉·哈丁在华盛顿的经历改变了她的人生。

example.en: They’re able to work through situations in a way that’s risk free.
example.zh: 他们能够以零风险的方式逐步应对各种情形。

example.en: Help students with mental issues pull through.
example.zh: 帮助有心理问题的学生渡过难关。

get through.zh: 用完，耗尽；通过；渡过（难关）

example.en: For instance, SpaceX’s Falcon 9 gets through 112 tonnes of refined fuel, emitting about 336 tonnes of CO₂.
example.zh: 例如，太空探索技术公司的猎鹰9号要消耗112吨精炼燃料，排放约336吨二氧化碳。

example.en: Most end users do not understand the terms after reading them through.
example.zh: 大多数终端用户读完这些条款后也不理解。

read through.note: 大部分出现在卷面说明 Read the passage through carefully

example.en: Basically, she miscalculated how fast she was burning through the money, and she’s now full of regret.
example.zh: 说到底，她算错了钱花得有多快，现在悔恨不已。

through rose-colored glasses.zh: 带着美化的眼光（看），过于乐观地

example.en: When people book holiday villas they are doing so through rose-colored
example.zh: 人们预订度假别墅时，往往是戴着玫瑰色眼镜在看。

through rose-colored glasses.note: 原句被截断，glasses 缺失；习语 see/look at sth through rose-colored glasses

example.en: They’re so used to being right and having quick answers that they don’t even realise when they’re making a mess by answering without thinking things through.
example.zh: 他们太习惯于自己正确、快速作答，甚至没意识到自己没想透就回答而搞砸了事情。

example.en: It is important to talk through these issues before they come to a head.
example.zh: 在这些问题激化之前把它们谈清楚很重要。

example.en: through day-to-day, make sure your present self knows what's in it for her too.
example.zh: 把它贯彻到日常中，要确保现在的你也知道这对她有什么好处。

follow through.note: 原句开头残缺，follow 缺失

example.en: We should see through other peoples’ attempt to make a prisoner of us.
example.zh: 我们应该看穿别人想把我们困住的企图。

most likely.zh: 很可能，十有八九；最有可能（be most likely to）

example.en: Some analysts find age 45+ jobless workers are most likely to be unemployed for more than a year.
example.zh: 一些分析人士发现，45岁以上的失业工人最有可能失业超过一年。

break up.zh: 打破，拆散；分解；（关系）破裂，分手

example.en: They break up nature's food supply chain.
example.zh: 它们破坏了自然界的食物供应链。

example.en: He ended up in the wrong place.
example.zh: 他最后到了错误的地方。

example.en: The drive has been going on for two weeks and Morris said just under 50 customers have picked up a free meal.
example.zh: 这项活动已进行两周，莫里斯说有近50位顾客领取了免费餐。

example.en: It had two of its domestic flights mixed up.
example.zh: 它把两个国内航班搞混了。

example.en: When she did sleep, she experienced “problem-solving dreams,” which left her feeling unrested when she woke up.
example.zh: 她真睡着时，会做“解决问题的梦”，这让她醒来时感觉没休息好。

example.en: She grew up in India.
example.zh: 她在印度长大。

turn up.zh: 出现，到场；被找到，冒出来

example.en: Bundles of £20 notes kept turning up.
example.zh: 一捆捆20英镑的钞票不断冒出来。

example.en: It has gone up sharply.
example.zh: 它大幅上涨了。

example.en: Volunteers visit the Games’ website to sign up.
example.zh: 志愿者访问运动会的网站报名。

example.en: When the island was put up for sale, it was offered to the local government but proved too expensive for the local authorities.
example.zh: 这座岛出售时，曾先向当地政府推荐，但当地政府觉得太贵了。

example.en: They set up a branch in Dubai to manufacture coffee roasters.
example.zh: 他们在迪拜设立了一个分公司，生产咖啡烘焙机。

example.en: To speed up investigation into criminal cases.
example.zh: 加快对刑事案件的调查。

example.en: He has stayed up playing computer games.
example.zh: 他一直熬夜玩电脑游戏。

example.en: Here, at this point in the argument, it’s traditional for me to bring up all the studies that show the benefits of napping.
example.zh: 论证到这里，按惯例我该提出所有说明午睡好处的研究了。

example.en: This inspired Andrea to get dressed up to take out the trash.
example.zh: 这启发安德莉亚打扮得漂漂亮亮去倒垃圾。

example.en: Poor people may have to give up eating certain foods because of their high prices.
example.zh: 穷人可能因为某些食物价格高而不得不放弃吃它们。

example.en: Indeed, as they get older and are given more freedom, they often ease up on social networking.
example.zh: 确实，随着年龄增长、获得更多自由，他们往往会减少使用社交网络。

example.en: They help each other to cover up their acts.
example.zh: 他们互相帮忙掩盖自己的行为。

example.en: They help to save up for larger houses.
example.zh: 它们有助于为买更大的房子攒钱。

example.en: Not to mention that soaking up new information can help you make more informed decisions when you
example.zh: 更不用说吸收新信息能帮助你在……时做出更明智的决定。

example.en: The black cat was found curled up under the engine cover of David King’s car when he decided to do an oil check after dropping his grandson off at school in Kent.
example.zh: 大卫·金把孙子送到肯特郡的学校后想检查机油，发现那只黑猫正蜷缩在他汽车的引擎盖下。

example.en: Each March, this tiny village swells up in numbers, because it is located in the middle of a race that takes place every year.
example.zh: 每年三月，这个小村子的人数都会激增，因为它正处在每年举行的一场比赛的赛道中间。

catch up.zh: 赶上，追上；补上（落下的）；（catch up on）补做

example.en: They need extra help to catch up in the math class.
example.zh: 他们需要额外帮助才能赶上数学课的进度。

catch up.note: 含 be caught up in（被卷入）一例

follow up.zh: 跟进，追踪调查；紧接着做

example.en: These results remained when researchers followed up six weeks later.
example.zh: 六周后研究人员再次跟进时，这些结果依然存在。

open up.zh: 打开；敞开心扉，坦率说出

example.en: Kate was depressed at first, but then she sat with some girl patients and they opened up all the boxes together, laughing and playing.
example.zh: 凯特起初很沮丧，但后来她和几位女孩患者坐在一起，大家一起打开所有盒子，又笑又玩。

example.en: That’s the perfect opportunity to speak up and get your burning company culture questions answered!
example.zh: 那是直言发问、让你对公司文化的迫切疑问得到解答的绝佳机会！

example.en: In more than a few passages, she relates the stories of men and women who came up against assembly-line medicine where patients were treated mostly as pieces of flesh.
example.zh: 在不少段落中，她讲述了一些男女的经历，他们遭遇了流水线式的医疗，病人几乎被当作一块块肉来对待。

example.en: It enables people to build up endurance.
example.zh: 它能使人增强耐力。

drum up.zh: 设法获得，招揽（支持、兴趣）

example.en: Birthday reminders can be helpful, but I kind of worry I won’t be able to drum up my own day and show it to look as exciting as it is supposed to be.
example.zh: 生日提醒也许有用，但我有点担心自己没法把自己的生日办得像应有的那样热闹精彩。

drum up.note: 此句 drum up 用法略不典型，释义按「鼓动，招来」推断

example.en: So the next week, Kate’s family loaded up their car and took all the dolls to the playroom at the children’s hospital.
example.zh: 于是下一周，凯特一家把车装满，带着所有娃娃去了儿童医院的游戏室。

example.en: As many as 20 students show up after school.
example.zh: 放学后多达20名学生会出现。

hold up.zh: 经得起检验，站得住脚；举起；耽搁；（举例）称赞

example.en: Although Keynes’s eight-fold figure holds up for the economy
example.zh: 尽管凯恩斯的八倍数字对经济而言站得住脚

hold up.note: 两句用法不同（站得住脚 / 举出来表扬）；例句为残缺句

example.en: They are burnt up in outer space.
example.zh: 它们在外太空被烧尽。

example.en: Then, the researchers compared answers to see how well responses to the two exercises matched up.
example.zh: 然后，研究人员比较答案，看两个练习的回答吻合得有多好。

example.en: Do you ever blend up a protein drink for breakfast or grab a protein bar following an afternoon workout?
example.zh: 你是否会在早餐时打一杯蛋白饮料，或在下午锻炼后随手拿一根蛋白棒？

blend up.note: blend 的普通用法，up 只是随附，不是固定短语，按 blend 的「搅拌」义项标；拿不准

put up.zh: 张贴，挂起；提供（资金）；搭建

example.en: They visit the store so much that staff have been forced to put up signs, asking their customers not to feed them.
example.zh: 它们来这家店太频繁，以至于店员不得不贴出告示，请顾客不要喂它们。

example.en: They can screw us up and set us back.
example.zh: 它们可能会毁了我们，让我们倒退。

clear up.zh: 澄清，消除（疑惑）；整理；（天气）放晴

example.en: Clear up confusion in the scientific community.
example.zh: 消除科学界的困惑。

example.en: It’s like fixing up an airplane engine and ignoring that the pilot is on his third drink at the bar and a massive storm is overhead.
example.zh: 这就像在修飞机引擎，却无视飞行员已在酒吧喝到第三杯、头顶还有一场巨大风暴。

example.en: Before long, people started offering up their own fancy dresses for her to wear.
example.zh: 不久，人们开始拿出自己漂亮的裙子给她穿。

offer up.note: up 仅加强语气，边缘；仅1句

example.en: "It's almost like the dark night is ending and the sun is coming up," said Ya Yung Teng, the digital collections coordinator for the Museum of Chinese in America.
example.zh: “就像黑夜快结束、太阳正在升起。”

come up.note: 此句 come up 只是字面的向上方向（日出），按 come/up 义项标，不算固定短语

back up.zh: 支持，证实；备份；（车辆）堵塞排队

example.en: And Game Academy reckons its belief is backed up by hard data.
example.zh: 游戏学院认为自己的看法有确凿数据支持。

example.en: who," he said, suggesting that some more equal dividing up of money might be more productive and
example.zh: 这不只是分配的问题。

mess up.zh: 弄糟，搞乱；（messed up）一团糟的

example.en: Responding to the post, one person commented that it is messed up beyond another level.
example.zh: 回应这条帖子时，有人评论说这事糟糕得超乎想象。

move up.zh: 晋升，在职位阶梯上上升

example.en: Success was once defined as being able to stay at a company for a long time and move up the corporate ladder.
example.zh: 过去，成功被定义为能在一家公司长期待下去并在公司内晋升。

example.en: Developing the habit of getting up early.
example.zh: 养成早起的习惯。

example.en: While that $18 difference per ticket may seem small, it adds up.
example.zh: 虽然每张票18美元的差价看似不大，但积少成多。

example.en: “Which matters more depends on what your history up until that point has been in the type of work you’re doing,”
example.zh: “哪个更重要，取决于你到那时为止在所做的这类工作上有怎样的经历。”

chalk up.zh: 把……归因于（chalk up sth to sth）；记下，获得

example.en: Li said “We often chalk up our stress to broad experiences like work.
example.zh: 李说：“我们常把压力归因于工作之类的宽泛经历。”

chalk up.note: 句中为 chalk up sth to sth 用法

example.en: In many cases, students did not realize that strategies like looking up answers on a smartphone were actually cheating at all.
example.zh: 在很多情况下，学生没有意识到用智能手机查答案之类的做法其实就是作弊。

example.en: Cheer them up instantly.
example.zh: 立刻让他们高兴起来。

example.en: Unlike many food waste projects that have sprung up in recent years
example.zh: 与近年来涌现的许多食物浪费项目不同

spring up.note: 仅1句，例句截取自截断原句，非完整句

example.en: Draw up a list of the efficiencies to be promised.
example.zh: 拟一份要承诺的节省措施清单。

example.en: For the presentation, I’ll bring my own laptop and hook it up to their projector.
example.zh: 演示时，我会带自己的笔记本电脑，把它连到他们的投影仪上。

example.en: Farmers ring up to receive the information.
example.zh: 农民们打电话来获取信息。

example.en: But if it heats up to 40 to 41 degrees, you may find yourself getting heatstroke.
example.zh: 但如果升到40到41度，你可能会中暑。

example.en: Flavoured water is booming: sales of the sparkling variety shot up by 20%, according to the latest analyst data.
example.zh: 风味水正在走红：据最新分析数据，起泡类的销量猛增了20%。

shoot up.note: 例句去掉了结尾残句 Meanwhile,

example.en: Therefore, I suggest you spend more time in the park with your friends, but make sure you apply lots of skin protection and fill up those water bottles, too.
example.zh: 因此我建议你多和朋友待在公园里，但一定要涂足防晒，并把水瓶都装满。

up to speed.zh: 跟上进度，掌握最新情况（get up to speed）

example.en: Diving headfirst into the crash course of starting university, I’ve quickly tried to get myself up to speed with the financial
example.zh: 一头扎进大学入学的速成课程，我很快努力让自己跟上财务方面的情况。

up to speed.note: canonical 可考虑 get up to speed；原句截断

example.en: Cacao seedlings are lined up in refrigerated greenhouses for a new experiment by using a technology called CRISPR.
example.zh: 可可幼苗在冷藏温室里排列好，用于一项采用CRISPR技术的新实验。

example.en: Would you like to join us?
example.zh: 你愿意加入我们吗？

example.en: I don’t feel like sandwiches today.
example.zh: 我今天不想吃三明治。

example.en: There’s nothing like playing as part of a unit to accomplish a goal like winning a game or even a championship.
example.zh: 没有什么比作为团队一员去完成赢得比赛甚至冠军这样的目标更好了。

nothing like.note: pos 取 adv. 类难定
