example.en: And that covers just three activities, and if other digital media activities were included, that estimate would no doubt rise.
example.zh: 这还只是三种活动；如果把其他数字媒体活动也算上，这个估计无疑还会上升。

example.en: She no longer has any money left.
example.zh: 她不再有钱了。

example.en: Anyone who is hungry and wants something to eat can take one, no questions asked and hand it to the staff for some food.
example.zh: 任何饿了想吃东西的人都可以拿一个，不会被追问，然后交给工作人员换取食物。

example.en: I landed badly during a fall and twisted it a little, but it’s no big deal.
example.zh: 我摔倒时落地姿势不好，稍微扭了一下，但没什么大不了。

example.en: No problem.
example.zh: 没问题。

example.en: No way!
example.zh: 不可能！

example.en: No wonder using mobile phones while driving causes more crashes a year than drink driving, says the U.S.
example.zh: 难怪开车时使用手机引发的车祸每年比酒驾还多。

example.en: She feels Jeremy would rather dine out.
example.zh: 她觉得杰里米更愿意出去吃。

example.en: The foxes were almost wiped out completely.
example.zh: 狐狸几乎被彻底消灭了。

example.en: It’s a shame you missed out on the general discount.
example.zh: 你错过了通用折扣，真可惜。

example.en: Get really specific with what’s stressing you out.
example.zh: 要把让你焦虑的事情想得非常具体。

stress out.note: 原句有引号和 Ms. 残片，已截取

work out.zh: 弄清，想出；算出；结果是；（事情）成功

example.en: But working out how to behave online is a new social skill.
example.zh: 但弄明白在网上该如何举止，是一项新的社交技能。

example.en: It’s what motivates non-human animals, human infants and probably human adults to explore and seek out new things before growing less interested in them after continued exposure.
example.zh: 这是促使非人类动物、人类婴儿，或许还有成年人去探索、寻找新事物的动力，之后在持续接触后才会兴趣减退。

example.en: It has to be carried out to the letter.
example.zh: 必须一丝不苟地执行。

example.en: Find out where Jimmy is.
example.zh: 查明吉米在哪里。

example.en: When you visit the grocery store, you might draw conclusions about the cashier who checks you out.
example.zh: 逛杂货店时，你可能会对给你结账的收银员下些判断。

example.en: I think social media too can intensify things as birthdays now play out more publicly.
example.zh: 我认为社交媒体也会加剧这种情况，因为现在生日的过法更公开了。

example.en: I mean, who wants to hang out with people in their suits?
example.zh: 我是说，谁想和穿着西装的人一起玩呢？

hang out.note: 原句开头 I 被OCR丢失，已补

example.en: When people set out to improve their health, they usually take a familiar path.
example.zh: 人们着手改善健康时，通常会走一条熟悉的路。

set out.note: 三句三种用法，例句截取冒号前

example.en: Six people had to move away from their home to another place after a fire broke out in a building on Main Street Saturday, officials said.
example.zh: 官员称，周六主街一栋楼发生火灾后，六人不得不搬离住处去别处。

example.en: To help busy people to sort out their priorities.
example.zh: 帮助忙碌的人理清轻重缓急。

example.en: They sent out a message to calm them down.
example.zh: 他们发出了一条让他们冷静的消息。

example.en: executives out of millions of pounds.
example.zh: 骗走高管们数百万英镑。

example.en: He points out that more than 200 genes influence weight.
example.zh: 他指出有超过200个基因影响体重。

example.en: In the absence of environmentally and economically feasible recycling options, fast-fashion manufacturers pump out low-quality clothes produced in high volumes that are worn only a few times and then discarded.
example.zh: 在缺乏环境和经济上可行的回收办法时，快时尚厂商大量生产质量低劣的衣服，这些衣服只穿几次就被丢弃。

example.en: Colleagues are most likely to take out time to socialize on the last work day of the week.
example.zh: 同事们最有可能在一周最后一个工作日抽出时间社交。

take out.note: id0 是残句；id1 为 take out time（≈take time out），边缘

example.en: No, sorry, I’m actually pretty worn out.
example.zh: 不好意思，我其实累坏了。

example.en: Well, I suggest reorganizing your notes using color-coded sections in your study guides, or using idea mapping to lay out the information and make it more quickly accessible.
example.zh: 我建议你在学习指南里用彩色编码的分区重新整理笔记，或用思维导图把信息铺陈出来，这样查起来更快。

example.en: On paper, my expenses and my financial aid just about even out.
example.zh: 账面上，我的开销和助学金差不多持平。

example.en: Keeping your name and joining it to your husband’s through hyphenation is as legal as simply adopting his name or as simply keeping your own and leaving his out of the picture entirely.
example.zh: 用连字符把你的姓和丈夫的姓连在一起，与直接改用他的姓，或只保留自己的姓而把他的姓排除在外，同样合法。

leave out.note: id0 为 left out 被排挤

example.en: To test this out, they conducted two studies.
example.zh: 为了检验这一点，他们开展了两项研究。

example.en: It made every effort to keep the essential capabilities of smartphones, but strip out costs and preserve battery life for people who likely have inadequate access to electricity.
example.zh: 它竭力保留智能手机的基本功能，但去掉成本，并延长电池续航，面向可能难以获得电力的人群。

example.en: Trying out innovative marketing strategies.
example.zh: 尝试创新的营销策略。

example.en: Fill out a more comprehensive checklist, and be wary of listed prices that seem too low.
example.zh: 填写一份更全面的清单，并警惕看起来过低的标价。

example.en: Do you prefer to fill out an application on the web, or to print it out and fill it in by hand and then post it back to us?
example.zh: 你是喜欢在网上填申请，还是打印出来手填再寄回给我们？

print out.note: 仅1句；该句同时含 fill out

example.en: If Kelli stands out, it’s because she is also a gifted writer.
example.zh: 如果说凯莉很出众，那是因为她还是个有天赋的作家。

example.en: It could be rolled out across the state.
example.zh: 它可以在全州推广。

example.en: Scientists can still help save chocolates from dying out!
example.zh: 科学家仍能帮助拯救巧克力免于灭绝！

example.en: wear out increasing the risk of developing type 2 diabetes.
example.zh: 磨损会增加患2型糖尿病的风险。

wear out.note: 仅1句且为残句，语境不明（wear out 作 磨损/耗尽 理解），建议核对原卷

example.en: Red Rum’s true talent came out in steeplechases.
example.zh: 红朗姆的真正才华在障碍赛马中显露出来。

example.en: They hit me right out of the gate with a $160 fee to attend my freshman orientation, a price which does not include the cost of travel to and from the District.
example.zh: 他们一上来就向我收了160美元参加新生入学指导，这还不包括往返该地区的路费。

out of the gate.note: 原句 of gate 缺 the，已补

example.en: An Italian study found that for simple arithmetic there was little difference between right- and left-handed performance, but for more difficult problem-solving, left-handers won out.
example.zh: 一项意大利研究发现，简单算术上左右手使用者差别不大，但在更难的解题上，左利手者胜出。

example.en: For now, the jury is still out as to how successful those endeavours will be.
example.zh: 目前，这些努力能有多成功仍无定论。

example.en: In the following two years, Red Rum lost out on the title, coming in second both times.
example.zh: 在接下来的两年里，红朗姆都屈居第二，与冠军失之交臂。

example.en: She didn’t just pass out food, she gave them love.
example.zh: 她不只是分发食物，还给了他们爱。

example.en: Please hear me out.
example.zh: 请听我把话说完。

example.en: What foods have been largely out of favor for more than a century?
example.zh: 哪些食物一百多年来基本上不受青睐？

example.en: And, of course, some researchers today still fund small-scale studies out of their own pockets.
example.zh: 当然，今天仍有一些研究者自掏腰包资助小规模研究。

example.en: He believes giving out this information will help Ohio’s colleges and universities to be more competitive.
example.zh: 他认为公布这些信息将有助于俄亥俄州的高校更具竞争力。

example.en: But there are promising students from struggling families across the nation who should not rule out their dream schools entirely.
example.zh: 但全国各地有不少来自困难家庭的优秀学生，不应该完全排除自己梦想中的学校。

example.en: Students may not be able to enjoy their state benefits when they go to college out of the state.
example.zh: 学生去州外上大学时，可能享受不到本州的福利。

example.en: We’re eating more fish than ever these days.
example.zh: 如今我们吃的鱼比以往任何时候都多。

example.en: It expects every individual to look their very best.
example.zh: 它期望每个人都尽量展现最好的一面。

look one's best.note: 各词义相加即可理解（look + best），属普通搭配

example.en: Even though we basically know what will happen, we keep coming back for more.
example.zh: 尽管我们基本知道会发生什么，我们还是一再回来看。

example.en: He has escaped the zoo once again.
example.zh: 它又一次从动物园逃走了。

example.en: I would have to stay with a friend or check into a hotel.
example.zh: 我只能住在朋友家，或者去酒店办理入住。

tap into.zh: 利用，开发（资源）；触及（情感、话题）

example.en: Birthdays can tap into a lot of things people worry about, including their achievements in life in the past decade, or their accomplishments of the past year.
example.zh: 生日会触及人们担心的很多事情，包括过去十年的人生成就，或过去一年的成绩。

example.en: It’s also true that too much social networking and game playing can cut into schoolwork and sleep.
example.zh: 过多的社交网络和游戏确实也会挤占学业和睡眠时间。

example.en: George Engel, in treating his patients, not only looks into their symptoms but also into things like the emotional support they receive.
example.zh: 乔治·恩格尔在治疗病人时，不仅研究他们的症状，也研究他们得到的情感支持之类的事。

look into.note: 两句都是「调查，研究」义；id 0 为残缺句

example.en: If you're especially into a piece of music, your brain does something called Autonomous Sensory Meridian Response
example.zh: 如果你特别喜欢某段音乐，大脑就会产生一种叫自发性知觉经络反应的现象。

example.en: Take other people’s preference into consideration.
example.zh: 要考虑别人的喜好。

take sth into consideration.note: 与 take sth into account 意思相同，但保留为两条写法

example.en: What should we take into account in order to make informed decisions?
example.zh: 为了做出明智的决定，我们应该考虑哪些因素？

example.en: Unless a far-reaching bottle ban does come into force, it will be up to consumers to not
example.zh: 除非影响深远的瓶装禁令真正生效，否则就要靠消费者自己不去……

come into force.note: 句子残缺，需自行补全译文

example.en: Many of us living in the most developed countries are buying into a myth of protein deficiency created by food companies
example.zh: 我们许多生活在最发达国家的人，都信了食品公司制造的蛋白质缺乏的神话。

example.en: Another interior designer commented that certain combinations can key into something on a deeper level, transporting you to a different moment in time.
example.zh: 另一位室内设计师说，某些搭配能在更深的层面触动人心，把你带回另一个时刻。

key into.note: 较生僻，仅一句；释义按语境推断

example.en: It could not have come into being without classical music and opera as its foundation.
example.zh: 没有古典音乐和歌剧作为基础，它不可能诞生。

example.en: Manufacturing costs come into effect, and commodities fluctuate in price based on demand and the distance to haul the
example.zh: 制造成本开始产生影响，商品价格随需求和运输距离而波动。

come into effect.note: 句子残缺；此处意为（成本）开始起作用

example.en: Go over his notes regularly.
example.zh: 要定期复习他的笔记。

example.en: Instead of receiving the standard care given to lab animals, the 60% group was watched over by a newcomer to the lab who, Kelli writes, “handled the animals differently.
example.zh: 60%那组没有得到实验动物的标准照料，而是由实验室的一名新人看护，凯莉写道，他对待动物的方式不同。

watch over.note: 句子较长且引号未闭合，例句不理想

example.en: They hand it over to the local government.
example.zh: 他们把它移交给当地政府。

example.en: Some think voice could soon take over from typing and clicking as the main way to interact online.
example.zh: 有人认为语音很快会取代打字和点击，成为网上互动的主要方式。

get over.zh: 克服；从（疾病、不快）中恢复

example.en: The part about getting over jetlag.
example.zh: 关于克服时差反应的部分。

example.en: I’ve been thinking it over, and I’d like to send him to Westwood Elementary.
example.zh: 我一直在考虑，我想送他去威斯特伍德小学。

example.en: Research by Amanda Lenhart of the Pew Research Centre, a US think tank, found that the most passionate texters are also the kids most likely to spend time with friends in person.
example.zh: 美国智库皮尤研究中心的阿曼达·伦哈特的研究发现，最爱发短信的孩子也最可能当面和朋友相处。

example.en: Thinking twice before buying something.
example.zh: 买东西前要三思。

example.en: Just make sure you’re logged in.
example.zh: 只要确保你已经登录。

example.en: Bottom line?
example.zh: 总之呢？

bottom line.note: 仅一句选项式短句，例句无实质内容，建议人工复核另选

example.en: She might have to cancel her registration any minute.
example.zh: 她随时可能不得不取消注册。

example.en: Wood has such health benefits that the Woodland Trust successfully lobbied for it to be prescribed by doctors.
example.zh: 木材有如此多的健康益处，以至于林地信托成功游说让医生把它开进处方。

such ... that.note: id 0 是 such as 义的 such things as，不是此短语；id 1 句首残缺

example.en: Before long, people started offering up their own fancy dresses for her to wear.
example.zh: 不久，人们就开始拿出自己的华服给她穿。

example.en: And before she knew it, she had done 20 weeks.
example.zh: 不知不觉，她已经坚持了二十周。

example.en: Alan was given away for adoption soon after he was born, and Walter never knew his father.
example.zh: 艾伦出生后不久就被送给别人收养，沃尔特则从未见过自己的父亲。

give away.note: id 0/1 为「（白白）送出」，id 2 为「送人收养」

give birth.zh: 生孩子，分娩（常用 give birth to）

example.en: Semba has given birth before.
example.zh: 桑巴以前生过孩子。

write off.zh: 认为……无价值而放弃；注销

example.en: With others, however, it is far easier to write them off.
example.zh: 但对另一些人，把他们一笔勾销要容易得多。

write off.note: 例句偏长；id 0 句更短但缺上下文

example.en: Start by writing down the things you didn’t like about previous employers, as well as the parts you really valued.
example.zh: 先写下你不喜欢前任雇主的地方，以及你真正看重的方面。

write down.note: down 有「记录」引申义，按 P 处理

as one pleases.zh: 随心所欲，想怎样就怎样

example.en: Well, I could come and go as I please, as long as I was getting the work done.
example.zh: 嗯，只要把工作完成，我可以随意来去。

example.en: They were meant to be reunited with the pet in their new home city in Texas.
example.zh: 他们本应在得克萨斯州的新家城市与宠物团聚。

example.en: Directions: Suppose your university is organizing a forum on how students can make the best use of on-campus resources for
example.zh: 指示：假设你们大学正在举办一场论坛，讨论学生如何充分利用校内资源……

example.en: Make full use of electronic devices.
example.zh: 要充分利用电子设备。

example.en: And speech obviously makes sense when you're driving.
example.zh: 开车时使用语音显然是合理的。

make sense.note: id 2 为 make sense of（弄懂）

make ends meet.zh: 使收支相抵，勉强维持生计

example.en: As a student from a family that is struggling to make ends meet, my financial aid package is a combination of federal grants and federal work study.
example.zh: 作为一个来自勉强维持生计家庭的学生，我的助学金由联邦补助和联邦勤工俭学组成。

example.en: Look after her grandfather.
example.zh: 照顾她的祖父。

one after another.zh: 一个接一个地，接连不断地

example.en: In a phantom traffic jam, the cars in the same lane slow down one after another, creating a wave-like effect.
example.zh: 在幽灵式堵车中，同一车道上的车辆一辆接一辆地减速，形成波浪效应。

example.en: How much did she win?
example.zh: 她赢了多少？

how much.note: 不是固定短语：how + much，按 much 义项标即可

example.en: Lying just off the North Sea coast, it found itself _27_ by an invasion of colored plastic eggs—much to the _28_ of local children, because the eggs contained toys.
example.zh: 它位于北海海岸边，被一大批彩色塑料蛋入侵，当地孩子们非常高兴，因为蛋里有玩具。

much to one's delight.note: 真题为填空题（delight 被挖空），例句含空格，不适合直接使用；也可视为 to one's delight 的变体

example.en: Being effective requires adaptability—something you don’t really learn in school, much less in a 6-month training camp.
example.zh: 要做到高效需要适应能力，这是你在学校里都学不到的，更不用说六个月的培训营了。

much less.note: 仅 id 2 是「更不用说」；id 0、1 只是 much + less（少得多），不算短语。例句为截取后半句

example.en: The toughness of the race allows for racers to eat pretty much whatever they want.
example.zh: 比赛的艰苦让选手几乎可以想吃什么就吃什么。

example.en: For all the innovation and choice that define the food and drink industries, if you want to make money, you could do a lot
example.zh: 尽管食品和饮料行业创新众多、选择丰富，但如果你想赚钱，不妨……

could do worse than.note: 句子被截断（could do a lot worse than 的结构），例句不完整；仅此一句，释义按习惯用法

find oneself.zh: 发现自己处于（某种状态、境地）

example.en: A few years ago I found myself teaching a university class on evil.
example.zh: 几年前，我发现自己在大学里教一门关于邪恶的课。

help oneself.zh: 随便吃（拿）；自己动手；自助

example.en: I imagine there will be different foods and people will just help themselves and eat at their own pace, right?
example.zh: 我想会有各种食物，大家自己取用，按自己的节奏吃，对吧？

example.en: They cannot help eating more than they should.
example.zh: 他们忍不住吃得过多。

example.en: As a student from a family that is struggling to make ends meet, my financial aid package is a combination of federal grants and federal work study.
example.zh: 作为一个来自勉强维持生计家庭的学生，我的助学金由联邦补助和联邦勤工俭学组成。

work study.note: 与 work-study 合并（canonical 为 work-study）

example.en: So, most people need their own car to get around.
example.zh: 所以大多数人需要自己的车出行。

example.en: You also get away from the habit of making guesses or following instincts.
example.zh: 你也就摆脱了凭猜测或直觉行事的习惯。

get away from.note: 例句偏长；id 0 为「摆脱（习惯）」

example.en: Congratulations on deciding to get married!
example.zh: 祝贺你决定结婚！

example.en: This inspired Andrea to get dressed up to take out the trash.
example.zh: 这启发安德莉亚盛装打扮去倒垃圾。

get ahead.zh: 取得进步，出人头地，领先

example.en: It hinders them from getting ahead.
example.zh: 这阻碍了他们出人头地。

example.en: The more you get right, the more creative you are thought to be because you have come up with uncommon associations.
example.zh: 你答对的越多，就越被认为有创造力，因为你想到了不常见的联想。

get sth right.note: get + 宾语 + right 属较松的搭配，勉强算短语；id 0 的 get right 省略了宾语

example.en: To feel how difficult it is to get his idea across.
example.zh: 体会让别人理解他的想法有多难。

get up to speed.zh: 尽快了解情况，迅速赶上

example.en: Diving headfirst into the crash course of starting university, I’ve quickly tried to get myself up to speed with the financial
example.zh: 一头扎进大学入学的速成课程，我迅速努力让自己了解财务方面的情况。

example.en: This way neither of you gets “your” way and you both have to deal with the legalities of going through a name change.
example.zh: 这样你们俩都不能随心所欲，还得去处理改名的法律手续。

get one's way.note: 真题中 your 加了引号，例句偏长

example.en: What is typical of Americans in the way of eating?
example.zh: 美国人在饮食方面有什么典型特点？

example.en: Meanwhile, they keep the milk, eggs, and other daily basics all the way back so you'll travel through as much of the store as possible, and be tempted along the way.
example.zh: 同时，他们把牛奶、鸡蛋等日常必需品放在最里面，让你尽可能多地逛过整个商店，沿途受到诱惑。

all the way.note: 例句偏长，仅此一句；此处 all the way back 为「一直在最里面」

example.en: Hello, good afternoon.
example.zh: 你好，下午好。

good afternoon.note: 问候语，pos 用 int.（不在规定列表内）；可视为不必收入短语表

example.en: Good morning.
example.zh: 早上好。

good morning.note: 问候语，pos 用 int.（不在规定列表内）；可视为不必收入短语表

example.en: Carla O’Shaughnessy from Sydenham was searching last year for a good deal to book a villa in Majorca for a summer break for the family.
example.zh: 来自锡德纳姆的卡拉·奥肖内西去年在找划算的价格，为家人的暑假预订马略卡岛的一栋别墅。

a good deal.note: 真题仅「划算的交易」义（good deal=优惠）

example.en: Should parents and teachers take away teens’ smartphones and replace them with paper books?
example.zh: 家长和老师应该拿走青少年的智能手机，换成纸质书吗？

example.en: The event will take place at Methodist University.
example.zh: 活动将在卫理公会大学举行。

take note.zh: 注意，留意（常用 take note of）

example.en: Take note of the message though fatigued.
example.zh: 尽管疲倦，也要留意这条信息。

example.en: A Club Where Lions Dance and Traditions Take Root
example.zh: 狮子起舞、传统生根的俱乐部

take root.note: 仅此一句，为标题，例句不完整

example.en: They decided that it was time to take control.
example.zh: 他们决定是时候掌控局面了。

take control.note: 普通动宾搭配（take + control），按 take 义项标即可

example.en: Let’s say your goal is to write a book.
example.zh: 比如说，你的目标是写一本书。

example.en: It involves being deviant, going against the social principle that people should tell the truth.
example.zh: 它涉及离经叛道，违背了人应当说真话的社会准则。

example.en: And alarmed locals contacted police, thinking they had heard bombs going off.
example.zh: 受惊的当地人联系了警方，以为自己听到了炸弹爆炸。

example.en: When Stanford University scholar Andrea Lunsford gathered data on the rates of errors in “freshman composition” papers going back to 1917, she found that they were virtually identical to today.
example.zh: 斯坦福大学学者安德莉亚·伦斯福德收集了可追溯到1917年的“大一作文”错误率数据，发现与今天几乎相同。

go back to.note: 此处为「追溯到」引申义；例句偏长

example.en: product is going on sale for real and the boys had to learn about budgeting and marketing, as well as designing their game.
example.zh: 产品真的要上市了，男孩们不得不学习预算和营销，以及设计他们的游戏。

example.en: How often he does shopping.
example.zh: 他多久购物一次。

how often.note: 不是固定短语：how + often，按 often 义项标即可

as is often the case.zh: 情况常常如此，往往如此

example.en: As is so often the case, clever marketing can beat reason; awareness is rarely enough.
example.zh: 情况常常如此：巧妙的营销能战胜理性，光有意识往往不够。

as is often the case.note: 真题为 as is so often the case；例句含选项字母 L)，去掉后可用，但带分号

example.en: allow us to feel like we are moving forward when we are merely spinning our wheels.
example.zh: 让我们在只是原地空转时，却觉得自己在前进。

example.en: As a student from a family that is struggling to make ends meet, my financial aid package is a combination of federal grants and federal work study.
example.zh: 作为一个来自勉强维持生计家庭的学生，我的助学金由联邦补助和联邦勤工俭学组成。

example.en: The American Psychological Association reports a gender gap year after year showing that women consistently report higher stress levels.
example.zh: 美国心理学会年复一年地报告存在性别差距，显示女性一直报告更高的压力水平。

example.en: Her daughter filmed it and the whole family laughed, but it seemed to go down well.
example.zh: 她女儿把它拍了下来，全家人都笑了，但它似乎很受欢迎。

example.en: “If someone is making up some conversation that might be interesting, it’s probably not going to land well,” says Pirson, whose expertise includes trust and well-being, mindfulness, and humanistic management.
example.zh: “如果有人编造一段可能有趣的对话，多半效果不会好，”皮尔森说，他的专长包括信任与幸福感、正念和人本管理。

well-being.note: 复合名词（单个词），不是短语，词表里按 well-being 单词处理

example.en: Staff did their best to discourage the pet from hanging around.
example.zh: 工作人员尽力阻止这只宠物在附近逗留。

example.en: Red Rum was passed around to several owners before being purchased for Noel Le Mar.
example.zh: 红朗姆在被诺埃尔·勒马尔买下之前，几经易主。

example.en: In our family, we talk openly about things like the budget for holidays, how taxes reduce your income, and how to shop around for the best deals.
example.zh: 在我们家，我们会坦率地谈论假期预算、税如何减少收入、怎样货比三家找到最优惠的价格这类事。

example.en: The more calories, the better.
example.zh: 热量越多越好。

the more..., the better.note: 变体含 the simpler the better 一类，统一为 the more..., the better 结构

example.en: To increase the benefits of fruit juice to our health, we’d better choose ripe fruit to make juice.
example.zh: 为了让果汁对健康更有益，我们最好选熟透的水果来榨汁。

had better.note: 情态用法，常缩写为 'd better

make history.zh: 创造历史；影响历史进程

example.en: What does the author think of the book Dress Codes: How the Laws of Fashion Made History?
example.zh: 作者怎么评价《着装规范：时尚法则如何塑造了历史》这本书？

make history.note: 两句均出自书名 Dress Codes: How the Laws of Fashion Made History，义偏「塑造历史」

make headlines.zh: 成为头条新闻，登上报纸头条

example.en: Two years ago, a Glasgow University study made headlines for suggesting gaming could make students more successful.
example.zh: 两年前，格拉斯哥大学的一项研究因提出玩游戏可能让学生更成功而登上了头条。

example.en: Make friends with Jimmy.
example.zh: 和吉米交朋友吧。

example.en: Let me see.
example.zh: 让我想想。

let me see.note: 口语套话，说话时的思考停顿

example.en: Cheating was getting more and more difficult for high school students.
example.zh: 作弊对高中生来说变得越来越难了。

high school.note: 复合名词，学习者应整体记；Marathon High School 等校名同义

example.en: They will find they have something in common.
example.zh: 他们会发现彼此有共同之处。

example.en: something like 15% of us achieve it.
example.zh: 大约百分之十五的人能做到。

example.en: have turned to claiming the problem is the opposite: There are too many cyclists getting in the way of cars.
example.zh: 骑车的人太多，挡了汽车的路。

get in the way.note: 句子被截断，译文取后半句

example.en: There are a lot of reasons to want to keep your own last name.
example.zh: 想保留自己的姓有很多理由。

last name.note: 复合名词，学习者应整体记

every last.zh: 每一个，最后一点也不放过

example.en: to every last detail.
example.zh: 直到每一个细节。

every last.note: 固定搭配 every last detail；仅1句且被截断，拿不准是否值得单列

example.en: Greenpeace, among others, is also
example.zh: 绿色和平组织等也……

feel free to do sth.zh: 随意做某事，请随便做某事

example.en: Please feel free to call me for any further questions.
example.zh: 如有其他问题，请随时打电话给我。

example.en: I don’t feel like sandwiches today.
example.zh: 我今天不想吃三明治。

feel like doing sth.note: 真题中两句均为 feel like + 食物，义为想吃

example.en: No one understands the reason for this.
example.zh: 没人理解其中的原因。

no one.note: no + one 字面相加即「没有人」，零基础可由义项读懂，不属需整体记的固定短语；若想保留作代词词条可改为 true

example.en: and chat with one another.
example.zh: 并且彼此聊天。

example.en: They can screw us up and set us back.
example.zh: 它们可能把我们搞砸，让我们倒退。

example.en: When people ask my son what he wants to be when he grows up, I have to swallow the urge to say, “Hey, back off my kid’s dreams!
example.zh: 当人们问我儿子长大后想做什么时，我得忍住不说：“嘿，别干涉我孩子的梦想！

back off.note: 此处是比喻义「别插手」，非字面退后；句末引号未闭合为原文截断

example.en: cutting back on family time?”, for example.
example.zh: 比如，减少陪伴家人的时间？

example.en: I want to contribute and give back to the community.
example.zh: 我想为社区做贡献并回馈社区。

give back.note: 去掉了开头引号；give sb sth back 也属此条

example.en: I’ll pay you back, of course.
example.zh: 当然，我会还你钱的。

example.en: Afterwards, the participants read a fictional survey of teens who wanted to “fight back against the companies by buying and
example.zh: 之后，参与者读了一份虚构的调查，其中的青少年想通过购买……来反击这些公司。

example.en: Play outdoors and enjoy themselves.
example.zh: 在户外玩耍，玩得开心。

example.en: There are now dozens of criminal cases in which offenders have passed themselves off as people of a different age, race
example.zh: 现在有数十起刑事案件，罪犯冒充成不同年龄、不同种族的人。

pass oneself off as.note: 原句有空格 ___31___，此处按答案补为 passed；句子被截断。与 pass off as 为同一短语，已合并

pay for itself.zh: 物有所值，自行回本（收益足以抵偿成本）

example.en: So, in the end, the rewards will pay for themselves.
example.zh: 所以，到头来这些回报自然会抵消成本。

pay for itself.note: 原写法 themselves 还原为 itself

example.en: To see how many people can go without napping.
example.zh: 看看有多少人可以不午睡。

go without.note: 第2句 go without 单独使用，意为什么也不要

example.en: To show off her riches and power.
example.zh: 为了炫耀她的财富和权力。

show off.note: 例句选 id0；id1 含方括号编号故不选

example.en: Transit Driver Appreciation Day has been celebrated across the country as far back as 2009.
example.zh: 交通司机感谢日早在2009年就已在全国庆祝。

example.en: Its participants came from various walks of life.
example.zh: 参加者来自各行各业。

walk of life.note: 常用复数 walks of life

example.en: the financial seas with no skills and no life jacket!
example.zh: 在金融的大海里，既没有技能，也没有救生衣！

life jacket.note: 复合名词；此处为比喻用法

example.en: A sentence for life.
example.zh: 终身监禁。

for life.note: 仅1句，且 for + life 偏透明，拿不准是否值得单列

example.en: They worry assistants will one day be used to deliver advertising directly to us.
example.zh: 他们担心助手有一天会被用来直接向我们投放广告。

example.en: are forced to close and students get an unexpected day off.
example.zh: 被迫关闭，学生意外得到一天假。

example.en: Weeks before the competitors arrive, the residents of Takotna start preparing for what is without question their biggest event of the year.
example.zh: 在塔科特纳的居民们在选手到来前几周就开始为他们无疑是一年中最盛大的活动做准备。

example.en: Of course, it’s possible to be a fountain of knowledge and a boring person, says public relations consultant Andrea Pass.
example.zh: 公关顾问安德烈娅·帕斯说，当然，一个人可以学识渊博却很无趣。

example.en: Sometimes a cat will walk on a phone and cut off the call, or they shut down the computers by walking onto the off switch.
example.zh: 有时猫会踩到电话上把通话切断，或者踩到关机键把电脑关掉。

example.en: Stress is so normalized that it is easy for women to shrug off those symptoms as simply the consequences of stress.
example.zh: 压力太常态化了，女性很容易把这些症状当成压力的正常后果而不当回事。

example.en: Police have sealed off the runway, and say it is unclear if it was an accident or an attempted robbery.
example.zh: 警方已封锁跑道，并表示尚不清楚这是一场事故还是一起未遂抢劫。

example.en: Given how unsettling and haunting nightmares can be, is there a way for dreamers to control, or even turn off, these bad dreams as they happen?
example.zh: 噩梦令人不安又挥之不去，做梦的人有没有办法在噩梦出现时控制甚至关掉它？

turn off.note: 此处 turn off 引申为让梦停止；原句空格 _27_ 按语义补为 control（推测，请核对原卷答案）

example.en: They extensively rip off legitimate websites and use a different website name.
example.zh: 他们大量仿冒正规网站，并使用不同的网站名称。

rip off.note: 真题义为仿冒；敲诈（宰客）为该短语另一常用义

example.en: Those between the ages of 18 and 34 prioritized it most, and that prioritization dropped off as respondents’ ages went up.
example.zh: 18至34岁的人最看重它，而这种重视程度随着受访者年龄增长而下降。

drop off.note: id1 为 drop sb off（送人到），含方括号编号故不选

example.en: It all started off when a movie star shared a photo of herself putting her trash bins out in a ball gown.
example.zh: 这一切始于一位电影明星分享了自己穿着晚礼服倒垃圾桶的照片。

start off.note: 常见 start off by doing

example.en: Taking a walk can be great for clearing your head or blowing off some steam.
example.zh: 散步非常适合让头脑清醒，或者发泄一下情绪。

blow off steam.note: 原句空格 ___32___ 按语义补为 clearing（推测，请核对原卷答案）

take off.zh: 起飞；流行起来，迅速发展

example.en: No injuries were reported on the plane, and the flight took off once again 7.5 hours after the first attempt.
example.zh: 飞机上无人受伤，航班在首次尝试7.5小时后又一次起飞。

take off.note: id0 与 id1 是被断成两行的同一句（took / off in 1970s...，义为流行起来）

example.en: They set off to inspect the site of the plane crash.
example.zh: 他们出发去查看飞机失事现场。

example.en: Of more than 9,700 people, roughly 85 percent were off base when asked to rate the quality of their diet.
example.zh: 在9700多人中，约85%的人在被要求给自己的饮食质量打分时都大错特错。

off base.note: 原句后接方括号编号及下一句，已截去

example.en: There are now dozens of criminal cases in which offenders have passed themselves off as people of a different age, race
example.zh: 现在有数十起刑事案件，罪犯冒充成不同年龄、不同种族的人。

pass off as.note: 与 pass oneself off as 为同一条（同一句），合并到该写法；原句空格按答案补为 passed

example.en: Getting back into work after you’ve been laid off is even harder.
example.zh: 被裁员之后再重返职场更难。

level off.zh: 趋于平稳，不再上升或下降

example.en: That’s because the volume of fish caught in the wild has leveled off since the 1990s.
example.zh: 这是因为野生捕捞的鱼量自20世纪90年代以来趋于平稳。

example.en: However, the joy of the moment wears off soon.
example.zh: 然而，一时的喜悦很快就会消退。

wear off.note: 原句空格 _31_ 按语义补为 wears（推测，请核对原卷答案）

example.en: Why friends break off contact all of a sudden.
example.zh: 为什么朋友会突然断绝联系。

example.en: While lions are not native to China, some versions of the story include the villagers creating a monster of their own in the shape of a lion to fight off the beast.
example.zh: 虽然狮子并非原产中国，但有些版本的故事说村民照着狮子的样子造出自己的怪物来对付那头野兽。

pay off.zh: 取得成功，有回报；还清（债务）

example.en: These closer bonds and greater attachment pay off.
example.zh: 这些更紧密的联系和更深的依恋会带来回报。

example.en: something, tearing it down, then building it up again.
example.zh: 把某物拆掉，再重新建起来。

tear down.note: down 表毁坏而非字面向下

shut down.zh: 关闭，停止运转；（情感上）封闭自己

example.en: They simply shut themselves down.
example.zh: 他们干脆把自己关闭了。

example.en: momentary thoughts were represented in words and passed down across generations.
example.zh: 一时的想法被用文字表达出来，并代代相传。

example.en: While pinning down a definition has proven tricky, the general consensus is it’s some means of information gathering.
example.zh: 尽管要确定一个定义很棘手，但大家普遍认为它是某种收集信息的方式。

example.en: They use new types of guns, and birds could easily be shot down in flight.
example.zh: 他们用新型枪支，鸟在飞行中很容易被击落。

example.en: Slowing down their ageing process.
example.zh: 减缓他们的衰老过程。

example.en: If we eat something too hot or too cold, or if the tooth is worn down enough where the tissue is exposed, all of those things cause pain, and then the pain causes the person not to use that tooth to try to protect it a little bit more.
example.zh: 如果我们吃了太烫或太凉的东西，或者牙齿磨损到暴露出组织的程度，这些都会引起疼痛，而疼痛又让人不去用那颗牙，以便多保护它一点。

wear down.note: 原句有空格 _29_（tissue 后一个词），例句中已删去该空格词；只有这1句，句子偏长

example.en: They’ll have pictures of a sales team and it might be a poor actor in New York that is down as their head of sales.
example.zh: 他们会放上销售团队的照片，而被列为销售主管的可能是纽约的一个蹩脚演员。

be down as.note: 较少见，仅1句；若觉得是 down as 的临时用法可考虑作废

example.en: Remind people to cut down on snacking.
example.zh: 提醒人们少吃零食。

cut down.note: 常接 on；真题中以「减少」为主，砍树仅1句

example.en: Most other healthy eating cultures also make meals an event—say, multiple courses around the family table, or a glass or two of red wine at a long lunch—as opposed to hastily wolfing down handfuls of cereal
example.zh: 其他大多数健康饮食文化也把用餐当成一件大事，比如全家围坐一桌吃好几道菜，或者在漫长的午餐中喝一两杯红酒，而不是匆匆忙忙狼吞虎咽地吃下几把麦片。

example.en: As such, they’re more likely to be “let down” by the experience.
example.zh: 因此，他们更可能对这次经历感到失望。

example.en: Cooling down volcanic rock with sea water.
example.zh: 用海水使火山岩冷却。

cool down.note: down 表降温而非字面向下

example.en: A deadly snake, which had finally been tracked down after escaping a zoo, has slipped away for the second time.
example.zh: 一条致命的蛇逃出动物园后终于被找到，却又第二次溜走了。

example.en: Nearly all of them closed down decades ago.
example.zh: 他们中几乎所有的几十年前就倒闭了。

example.en: They sent out a message to calm them down.
example.zh: 他们发出一条消息让他们平静下来。

example.en: breaks down glucose in your blood or muscles.
example.zh: 分解你血液或肌肉中的葡萄糖。

example.en: British astronaut Tim Peake is stepping down permanently from his role as a European astronaut.
example.zh: 英国宇航员蒂姆·皮克将永久卸任欧洲宇航员一职。

example.en: ranking in Overwatch should go down in your resume?
example.zh: 在《守望先锋》中的排名该不该写进你的简历？

go down in.note: 此处为 go down in your resume，类似 go down in history（载入史册）；仅1句且被截断，拿不准

example.en: And it’s true; turning down opportunities is easier when you can fall back on the safety net provided by power, money, and authority.
example.zh: 确实，当你有权力、金钱和权威构成的安全网可依靠时，拒绝机会会容易得多。

example.en: This is down to climate change, he believes.
example.zh: 他认为这是气候变化造成的。

be down to.note: 英式用法；还有「轮到某人」「只剩下」等义，真题仅归因义

example.en: Lion dance should be handed down to future generations as part of Chinese culture.
example.zh: 狮舞应作为中华文化的一部分传给子孙后代。

example.en: And yet, savings rates in the U.S. have gone down in recent decades, not up.
example.zh: 然而，美国的储蓄率近几十年来一直在下降，而不是上升。

example.en: To enable them to settle down in host countries.
example.zh: 让他们能在东道国安顿下来。

settle down.note: 第2句 settle down 义为安顿下来（猫窝下）

example.en: They try hard to pull down the safeguards for research.
example.zh: 他们拼命想拆掉对研究的保障措施。

example.en: Looked down upon by male colleagues.
example.zh: 被男同事看不起。

look down on.note: 句中为 look down upon，同义

come across.zh: 偶然遇到，偶然发现；（come across as）给人……的印象

example.en: Local policemen came across bundles of £20 notes.
example.zh: 当地警察偶然发现了成捆的20英镑纸币。

come forward.zh: 站出来，挺身而出；主动提供（信息）

example.en: The snake may be taken to a local zoo for care if the owner does not come forward.
example.zh: 如果主人不站出来认领，这条蛇可能会被送到当地动物园照料。

example.en: Recently, the clothing industry has come under attack for creating a waste problem with serious environmental consequences.
example.zh: 最近，服装业因造成会带来严重环境后果的浪费问题而受到批评。

example.en: So, it should come as no surprise to anyone that classical music pieces are still used as background music in modern movies.
example.zh: 所以，古典音乐作品仍被用作现代电影的背景音乐，这不会让任何人感到意外。

come as no surprise.note: 句子被截断，例句已按原卷 cet4_2025_06_2 补全。

first come, first served.zh: 先到先得的，按先后顺序服务的

example.en: The same discount of 20% is being offered to everyone at the door on a “first come, first served” basis for the first month.
example.zh: 第一个月，在门口按“先到先得”的原则向所有人提供同样的八折优惠。

first come, first served.note: 例句已去掉说话人标记和编号。

example.en: is not how the two pieces of work and life come together.
example.zh: ……并不是工作和生活这两部分结合在一起的方式。

come together.note: 仅一句且是残句，意思按“结合、融合”判断。

example.en: Both groups attach importance to social connections.
example.zh: 两组人都重视社会联系。

example.en: For example, if someone breaks the law, the golden rule would suggest that we should let them go, because we would not want to be punished ourselves.
example.zh: 例如，如果有人犯了法，黄金法则会建议我们放他们走，因为我们自己也不想受到惩罚。

let go.note: 例句偏长，但两句里另一句是对话残句，意思“放手，不计较”。

example.en: Its crew members went on strike.
example.zh: 它的机组人员罢工了。

go ahead.zh: （计划等）继续进行，获准进行；（对人）请便

example.en: Surprisingly, the Space Roaster concept—should it go ahead—will not be the first attempt to take coffee into space.
example.zh: 令人惊讶的是，“太空烘焙机”这一构想（如果能推进的话）并不是首次尝试把咖啡带入太空。

go ahead.note: 原句含破折号插入语，无括号。

example.en: And then, if you still wanted to give money as some sort of apology or something, he probably shouldn’t have to go around borrowing it from people.
example.zh: 然后，如果你还想给一笔钱作为某种道歉，他大概也不该四处向别人借钱。

go around.note: 拿不准：此处是 go around doing（到处做），带引申义，勉强算短语；仅一句。

example.en: They prefer to go after all that is novel.
example.zh: 他们更喜欢追求一切新奇的东西。

example.en: It assumes that human beings are all good-natured.
example.zh: 它假定人类都是善良的。

example.en: Let’s order Vietnamese right away.
example.zh: 我们马上点越南菜吧。

example.en: What movie are you showing right now?
example.zh: 你们现在在放什么电影？

example.en: People in France are keeping away from the narrow French stick loaf in favor of healthier, cheaper options, a millers association has said.
example.zh: 一家面粉商协会表示，法国人正在远离细长的法棍面包，转而选择更健康、更便宜的食品。

be anything to go by.zh: 如果以……为依据（判断）；若可作参考

example.en: district is anything to go by.
example.zh: ……如果以该学区为依据来判断的话。

be anything to go by.note: 仅一句且被截断，原句为 “if the vigorous debate on the Facebook page of Anderson County school district is anything to go by”；固定表达 if ... is anything to go by。

example.en: Kelli wastes no time taking potshots at the medical establishment and its body-centered biomedicine methods.
example.zh: 凯莉毫不迟疑地随意抨击医疗机构及其以身体为中心的生物医学方法。

take potshots at.note: 例句已删去括号内的中文注释。

example.en: They are taken as memos of understanding.
example.zh: 它们被当作谅解备忘录。

take sth as.note: 拿不准：take A as B 可视为一般搭配，但“把……视为”对学习者有整体记忆价值，保留。

example.en: What should we take into account in order to make informed decisions?
example.zh: 为了做出明智的决定，我们应该考虑什么？

example.en: People tend to want as many choices as possible.
example.zh: 人们往往想要尽可能多的选择。

as many as possible.note: 与 as much / as early / as few as possible 合并为句型 as ... as possible。

example.en: The goal in this is to make the fans connect to the live experience as much as possible, and the tools you have to do that, we're not using at all.
example.zh: 这样做的目标是让粉丝尽可能多地与现场体验建立联系，而为此可用的工具，我们根本没有使用。

as much as possible.note: 与 as many / as early / as few as possible 合并为 as ... as possible；5 句里没有短句，此句尚可。

example.en: It should be avoided if possible.
example.zh: 如果可能，应该避免这样做。

example.en: One should start saving as early as possible.
example.zh: 人应该尽早开始储蓄。

as early as possible.note: 与 as many / as much / as few as possible 合并为 as ... as possible。

example.en: Contrary to parents’ belief, kids try hard to leave as few traces as possible on the web.
example.zh: 与父母的想法相反，孩子们努力在网上留下尽可能少的痕迹。

as few as possible.note: 与 as many / as much / as early as possible 合并为 as ... as possible。

example.en: This means that they strive to implement the golden rule whenever possible, as long as it doesn’t clash with a more important concept.
example.zh: 这意味着只要可能，他们就努力践行黄金法则，只要它不与更重要的理念冲突。

whenever possible.note: 拿不准：字面可推出，但属常用固定说法，保留。

follow sb's lead.zh: 效仿某人，以某人为榜样

example.en: He hopes private institutions in Ohio follow the lead of the state and post similar information.
example.zh: 他希望俄亥俄州的私立机构效仿该州，公布类似的信息。

follow sb's lead.note: 例句取自原句后半段，改写主语为 He（原句为 He notes ..., but he hopes ...），无括号。

drive sth home.zh: 使深入人心，使（人）深刻认识到

example.en: That reality was driven home this month by a new Los Angeles Homeless Services Authority report showing that the county's homeless population is growing faster than the supply of new housing.
example.zh: 洛杉矶无家可归者服务局本月的一份新报告让人深刻认识到了这一现实：该县无家可归人口的增长快于新住房的供应。

example.en: It will gradually pass away without teachers' help.
example.zh: 没有老师的帮助，它会逐渐消失。

pass away.note: 真题里用的是“消失”义，而不是常见的“去世”。

example.en: Palmdor is the perfect place to retreat to, somewhere to get away from the city noise and relax in beautiful surroundings with zero stress.
example.zh: 帕尔多是个绝佳的休憩之地，可以远离城市的喧嚣，在优美的环境中毫无压力地放松。

example.en: The vast island usually locks away enough fresh water in its ice sheet, which if melted can raise global sea levels by six meters.
example.zh: 这座广阔的岛屿通常把足够多的淡水封存在冰盖里，这些水一旦融化，可使全球海平面上升六米。

example.en: Kids tend to take note if their parents put their phone away at dinner or charge it in another room while they sleep.
example.zh: 如果父母在晚饭时把手机收起来，或在睡觉时把手机放到另一个房间充电，孩子往往会留意到。

put away.note: 例句已去掉前半句含空格填 _34_ 的部分。

example.en: They will not fade away from the public eye.
example.zh: 它们不会从公众视野中逐渐消失。

example.en: Everything from specialist cheeses to sought-after coffee beans gets thrown away every day in the current food system.
example.zh: 在当前的食品体系里，从特色奶酪到抢手的咖啡豆，各种东西每天都被扔掉。

turn away.zh: 使远离，使转移；拒绝（某人）入内

example.en: It has largely failed to turn teens away from junk food.
example.zh: 它基本上没能让青少年远离垃圾食品。

example.en: The best entertainment and storytelling comes from people who are relatable—those who don’t shy away from opening up but freely share who they are and what they care about.
example.zh: 最好的娱乐和叙事来自让人有共鸣的人——那些不回避敞开心扉、而是坦然分享自己是谁、在乎什么的人。

example.en: Bacteria accumulate because there isn’t enough water in your mouth to wash it away.
example.zh: 细菌之所以积聚，是因为你口中没有足够的水把它冲走。

explain away.zh: （通过解释）消除，排除；辩解开脱

example.en: None of these explained away the gender gap, so we applied data collected from surveys that express consumer preferences.
example.zh: 这些因素都没能解释掉性别差距，所以我们采用了通过调查收集的、体现消费者偏好的数据。

explain away.note: 例句截去了原句后半段，句末以句号收尾。

example.en: Simply put, countries stick to darker and more conservative colors because they appear more official.
example.zh: 简单地说，各国坚持使用较深、较保守的颜色，是因为它们显得更正式。

example.en: A lot of research comes to the same conclusion that fruit juice does harm to the human body when it leads to surplus
example.zh: 许多研究得出了相同的结论：果汁导致热量过剩时会对人体有害。

come to a conclusion.note: 例句是残句，末尾被截断。

hear from.zh: 收到（某人的）来信或消息，得到……的音讯

example.en: We haven’t heard from him since.
example.zh: 那以后我们就再没有他的消息了。

example.en: The dog owner’s family are currently in the process of moving.
example.zh: 狗主人一家目前正在搬家。

big deal.zh: 大事；重要人物（no big deal：没什么大不了）

example.en: I landed badly during a fall and twisted it a little, but it’s no big deal.
example.zh: 我摔倒时落地姿势不好，稍微扭了一下，但没什么大不了。

example.en: Sure thing.
example.zh: 当然没问题。

example.en: he damaged someone’s car and wanted to get some money together to make up for the damage he’d caused.
example.zh: 他损坏了别人的车，想凑一些钱来弥补自己造成的损失。

get sth together.note: 例句从原句中截取后半句，已去掉前面的 “Nothing serious, mind you, but”。

example.en: But when people make decisions for others, they typically put together a more diverse team.
example.zh: 但当人们为别人做决定时，他们通常会组建一个更多元化的团队。

example.en: With the validity of science coming under attack, there’s a need for scientific debates to be perceived as open and true to life.
example.zh: 随着科学的有效性受到质疑，科学辩论需要被视为开放且贴近生活的。

come under.note: 该句实为 come under attack，已并入 come under attack。

ever since.zh: 自从那时以来，从那以后；自从……以来

example.en: She has lived there ever since.
example.zh: 从那以后她一直住在那里。

example.en: The growing trend of eating out.
example.zh: 外出就餐日益增长的趋势。

example.en: To feel how difficult it is to get his idea across.
example.zh: 去感受把他的想法表达清楚有多难。

example.en: He prefers to stay next door to the children.
example.zh: 他更愿意住在孩子们的隔壁。

example.en: If you find yourself searching for something to say beyond small talk, try these tactics to find more interesting approaches to conversation.
example.zh: 如果你发现自己想在闲聊之外找点话说，试试这些策略，找到更有趣的交谈方式。

example.en: In our house, we have transparent money boxes for them to put small change in, so they can see their savings grow.
example.zh: 在我们家，有透明的储蓄罐让他们存放零钱，这样他们就能看到自己的积蓄在增长。

put the spotlight on.zh: 使成为焦点，使受到关注

example.en: sugar's role in heart disease-and put the spotlight squarely on dietary fat.
example.zh: ……糖在心脏病中的作用，并把焦点完全放到了膳食脂肪上。

put the spotlight on.note: 原句 OCR 有乱码（spotlight 后），例句已按原卷改为 “squarely on dietary fat”；原句为残句。

example.en: It was put forward by King Kullen.
example.zh: 它是由金·库伦提出的。

example.en: The researchers put forth policy contributions, ranging from sustainable disposal of leftover stock to production tax to incentivize both manufacturers and consumers to be more waste conscious.
example.zh: 研究人员提出了政策建议，从可持续处理剩余库存到征收生产税，以激励制造商和消费者提高减少浪费的意识。

put forth.note: 与 put forward 同义但写法不同，未合并。

example.en: People think focus means saying ‘yes’ to the thing you’ve got to focus on.
example.zh: 人们认为专注意味着对你必须专注的那件事说“是”。

have got to.note: 例句取自引语部分，去掉了 G) 和引号。

example.en: What's more, homes built in the 2000s were more likely than earlier models to have more of all types of spaces; bedrooms, bathrooms, living rooms, dining rooms, recreation rooms and garages.
example.zh: 此外，2000年代建造的住宅比早期住宅更可能拥有更多各种类型的空间：卧室、浴室、客厅、餐厅、娱乐室和车库。

living room.note: 句中的分号无妨；唯一一句，较长。

play a role.zh: 起作用，扮演角色，发挥作用

example.en: They play increasingly more important roles.
example.zh: 它们发挥着越来越重要的作用。

example.en: I still kept wishing that I didn’t have to play catch-up with the money world.
example.zh: 我仍一直希望自己不必在金钱世界里奋起直追。

play catch-up.note: 例句去掉了前面的从句 while I was researching。

example.en: They are able to bring their potential into fuller play.
example.zh: 他们能够让自己的潜力得到更充分的发挥。

example.en: It’s written by a Chinese science fiction writer.
example.zh: 它是由一位中国科幻作家写的。

take notice.zh: 注意到，留意（常作 take notice of）

example.en: When an experimenter from the research team took notice.
example.zh: 当研究团队的一名实验人员注意到时。

example.en: transformation project gone wrong, where swollen expectations have been popped and a long list of
example.zh: ……一个出了问题的转型项目，其中膨胀的期望已被戳破……

go wrong.note: 仅一句且是残句，gone wrong 作后置定语。

example.en: Beat challenges and take risks.
example.zh: 战胜挑战，勇于冒险。

example.en: If we can show the possibilities of eating plant-based food in this setting, it can open a lot of doors for others to follow.
example.zh: 如果我们能在这种环境中展示吃植物性食物的可能性，就能为其他人打开许多扇门，让他们效仿。

open doors.note: 拿不准：open doors 是 open the door(s) to 的变体，仅一句，按“带来机会”判断；例句中去掉了引号。

example.en: The rate of wage increase in terms of purchasing power has slowed down for years.
example.zh: 按购买力计算的工资增长率已经放缓多年。

example.en: It will also bring to an end a less popular US high school tradition: the “make-up day”
example.zh: 它还将终结美国高中一项不太受欢迎的传统：“补课日”。

bring to an end.note: 例句是原句的截断，末尾无句号。

bring back.zh: 使恢复，使重新出现；使回到；带回

example.en: Technology companies are partnering with educators to bring back good, old-fashioned play.
example.zh: 科技公司正在与教育工作者合作，让美好的传统游戏重新回归。

example.en: Blood sugar cause the release of insulin to bring it back down to a stable level.
example.zh: 血糖会促使胰岛素释放，把它重新降到稳定的水平。

bring down.note: 例句是截断的残句，开头大写为改动。

example.en: So have you got your mind set on a specific model?
example.zh: 那你已经看中某个具体型号了吗？

second nature.zh: 第二天性，习惯成自然的事

example.en: You probably have to help younger children plan their session, but it’s important that by the end of primary school it’s second nature.
example.zh: 你可能得帮年幼的孩子规划学习时段，但重要的是到小学结束时，这应成为他们的第二天性。

example.en: You have to pay back your commitment at some point.
example.zh: 你总有一天要兑现你的承诺。

at some point.note: 拿不准：属于“point = 时刻”的引申义，可算整体记忆；与 at this point 口径一致，保留。

example.en: But he is just not mature enough to live on his own at this point.
example.zh: 但他目前还不够成熟，不能独自生活。

at this point.note: 含 at that point 的变体句（例句取第 3 句末半句，已去掉前面句子）；口径同 at some point。

example.en: Yes, it really can be difficult getting a new job after age 45, let alone changing careers.
example.zh: 是的，45岁以后找新工作确实很难，更不用说转行了。

turn around.zh: 转身，掉头；（突然）转而，反过来

example.en: Companies cannot do all these things to enhance women’s advancement and then turn around and say, ‘Oh, but we don’t expect the men to take over for the women at home.
example.zh: 公司不能做了所有这些促进女性晋升的事，然后又转过头来说：“哦，但我们并不指望男性在家里接替女性。

turn around.note: 含一句字面义（航班掉头返航）和一句引申义（转而说），整体算短语；例句去掉了引号收尾处的残缺。

example.en: They usually turn a blind eye to their own weaknesses.
example.zh: 他们通常对自己的弱点视而不见。

feel free to.zh: 随意，不必客气地（做某事）

example.en: Please feel free to call me for any further questions.
example.zh: 如有任何其他问题，请随时给我打电话。

example.en: I had no idea Japan made jeans.
example.zh: 我根本不知道日本生产牛仔裤。

no idea.note: 规范写法用 have no idea。

example.en: The brightest people and strongest leaders sometimes make errors others don’t, especially in situations that require common sense.
example.zh: 最聪明的人和最强的领导者有时会犯别人不会犯的错误，尤其是在需要常识的情况下。

common sense.note: count=4 中 2 句是 Common Sense Media（机构名，不是该短语），实际有效仅 2 句（含 It would make sense / common sense 的长句）。

a body of.zh: 大量的，一批（研究、证据、作品等）

example.en: The findings are important because there is a growing body of evidence that dogs can help children in many ways.
example.zh: 这些发现很重要，因为越来越多的证据表明狗能在许多方面帮助孩子。

example.en: Have meals as usual to stay away from hunger.
example.zh: 照常吃饭以免挨饿。

example.en: They can reduce unwanted side effects of certain medicines.
example.zh: 它们能减少某些药物不必要的副作用。

side effect.note: 与 side effects 合并，规范写单数

example.en: Observational studies like this one cannot prove cause and effect.
example.zh: 这样的观察性研究无法证明因果关系。

cause and effect.note: 例句为原句截取前半句

example.en: I’m looking for a present for my nephew, Lawrence.
example.zh: 我在给我的侄子劳伦斯找一份礼物。

example.en: It originated in the United States.
example.zh: 它起源于美国。

the united states.note: 专有名词（国名），不是固定短语；states 任务中应标 X

example.en: Compared with other racing series, Formula One focuses more on speed and involves more danger.
example.zh: 与其他赛车系列赛相比，一级方程式更注重速度，也更危险。

compare with.note: 与 compare to 合并（compared with/to 在真题里同义），规范写 compare with

example.en: Those who are relatively old compared to their classmates have certain advantages over them.
example.zh: 年龄比同班同学相对大的人比他们有一些优势。

example.en: It will come true sooner or later.
example.zh: 它迟早会实现。

example.en: Keep it under control.
example.zh: 把它控制住。

example.en: It can reduce companies’ real estate costs.
example.zh: 它可以降低公司的房地产成本。

example.en: For that age group, our biggest seller this year has been this action figure.
example.zh: 对这个年龄段来说，我们今年卖得最好的就是这款人偶玩具。

move forward.zh: 向前发展，取得进展；继续前进

example.en: Expect future success so as to move forward.
example.zh: 期待未来的成功，以便不断前进。

move forward.note: 真题里均为引申义（向前推进），不是单纯位置移动

example.en: We can never be truly free if taking to heart others’ opinion of us.
example.zh: 如果总把别人对我们的看法放在心上，我们就永远无法真正自由。

example.en: It doesn’t take donations and doesn’t want to be seen as a charity.
example.zh: 它不接受捐款，也不想被看作慈善机构。

example.en: The technology is also known as autonomous cruise control.
example.zh: 这项技术也被称为自动巡航控制。

example.en: They are known for their loyalty to their owners.
example.zh: 它们以对主人忠诚而闻名。

example.en: Generally speaking, soft cheeses are creamy and go well with sweet things like honey and jam.
example.zh: 一般来说，软奶酪质地绵滑，很适合搭配蜂蜜、果酱之类的甜食。

example.en: To make sure this wasn't by chance, Wang conducted additional tests.
example.zh: 为确保这不是偶然，王进行了额外的测试。

example.en: Researchers have previously found a link between eating more fruits and vegetables, and improved longer term mental health.
example.zh: 研究人员此前发现，多吃水果蔬菜与长期心理健康的改善之间存在关联。

long term.note: 真题中为 longer term（比较级），常写作 long-term

example.en: Skills shortages in many jobs such as animation and special effects.
example.zh: 动画和特效等许多工作都存在技能人才短缺。

example.en: They can reduce unwanted side effects of certain medicines.
example.zh: 它们能减少某些药物不必要的副作用。

example.en: It’s estimated at less than one per cent of the UK’s food waste total.
example.zh: 据估计，它占英国食物浪费总量的不到百分之一。

example.en: So have you got your mind set on a specific model?
example.zh: 那么你心里有看中的具体型号了吗？

set one's mind on.note: 真题为被动式 have one's mind set on

example.en: Participants were then placed in a virtual reality setting.
example.zh: 随后参与者被置于一个虚拟现实的环境中。

example.en: Living beyond her means.
example.zh: 过着超出自己经济能力的生活。

example.en: What do we learn about New York’s Eleven Madison Park?
example.zh: 关于纽约的麦迪逊十一号公园餐厅，我们了解到什么？

new york.note: 专有名词（地名），不是固定短语；york 任务中应标 X

example.en: It has led some other companies to follow suit.
example.zh: 这促使其他一些公司也效仿。

near miss.zh: 差一点成功（的尝试）；险些发生的事故

example.en: There’s sometimes no penalty to a near miss.
example.zh: 有时差一点成功并不会受到惩罚。

near miss.note: 原句被截断；主旨“差一点成功”

example.en: They are nowhere near as popular as they used to be when we were children.
example.zh: 它们远不如我们小时候那么受欢迎了。

example.en: Whether that’s likely, or even possible, anytime soon, is anyone’s guess.
example.zh: 这在短期内是否有可能、甚至是否可行，谁也说不准。

example.en: Another potential red flag is being asked to pay by bank transfer.
example.zh: 另一个潜在的危险信号是被要求通过银行转账付款。

example.en: He is a sign language interpreter.
example.zh: 他是一名手语翻译。

example.en: Scotland will reach the national target in carbon emissions reduction ahead of schedule.
example.zh: 苏格兰将提前实现国家碳减排目标。

example.en: Learning can benefit you by itself but only practice can turn what you learn into meaningful contributions.
example.zh: 学习本身对你有益，但只有实践才能把所学变成有意义的贡献。

by itself.note: 同 by oneself 系列；真题含 Not by itself（单靠这个不行）

example.en: You probably haven't taken the time to think of all the work that went into creating the shirt on your back.
example.zh: 你多半没花时间想过，你身上这件衬衫在制作中投入了多少工作。

go into.note: 真题均为 effort/work goes into sth 的引申义

example.en: Rush hour in this city is killing me.
example.zh: 这座城市的高峰时段快把我折磨死了。

example.en: That means no running red lights or traveling in the opposite direction of traffic on one-way streets.
example.zh: 这意味着不能闯红灯，也不能在单行道上逆行。

run a red light.note: 真题为 running red lights（复数）

example.en: It was caused by a lorry running into a trailer.
example.zh: 事故是一辆货车撞上一辆拖车造成的。

example.en: Well, for example, the subway system could have air conditioning.
example.zh: 比如说，地铁系统可以装上空调。

example.en: He said the people who should be paying regard to the Wang paper are the funding agents.
example.zh: 他说，应该重视王这篇论文的是出资机构。

pay regard to.note: 例句为原句截取（原句被截断）；更常见写法为 pay regard to / have regard to

example.en: that teenagers will be able to take a natural history test
example.zh: 青少年将能参加博物学测验。

natural history.note: 原句被截断，example 为截取简化，建议复核

example.en: There are some factors that could affect the budget moving forward.
example.zh: 有一些因素今后可能会影响预算。

moving forward.note: 与 move forward（向前发展）意思不同，不合并

example.en: Barely capable of moving ahead.
example.zh: 几乎无法向前移动。

move ahead.note: ahead 只表示字面的方向，move + 方向，不算固定短语

example.en: At around half past nine this morning, a trailer attached to a lorry turned over at the crossing of High Street in Milton.
example.zh: 今天上午九点半左右，一辆货车挂着的拖车在米尔顿高街的路口翻倒了。

turn over.note: 只有一句，turn over 偏字面翻转，但“翻车”义学习者不易推出，保留；可复核

example.en: Fats and sugar have taken the beating in turns since over a century ago.
example.zh: 一个多世纪以来，脂肪和糖轮番遭到抨击。

in turns.note: 例句为原句截取前半；标准写法常为 in turn / in turns

example.en: A good suit works wonders for our performance in the boardroom.
example.zh: 一套好西装对我们在会议室的表现有奇效。

example.en: We understand instinctively that the stories we hold in common are an important part of the ties that bind.
example.zh: 我们本能地明白，我们共有的故事是维系彼此的纽带的重要组成部分。

hold sth in common.note: 规范写法 have sth in common（真题里动词为 hold）；例句为原句截取

get sb nowhere.zh: 对某人毫无帮助，徒劳无功

example.en: It gets us nowhere.
example.zh: 这对我们毫无帮助。

example.en: Human fascination with animals goes back as far as humans do.
example.zh: 人类对动物的迷恋可以追溯到人类诞生之初。

go back.note: 真题均为引申义“追溯到”（不是“回去”），若为字面义才不算短语；例句为原句截取

example.en: The relationship probably goes two ways.
example.zh: 这种关系很可能是双向的。

go both ways.note: 真题原文是 goes two ways，普通搭配（go + 数量），不是固定短语

example.en: It induces people to fall asleep.
example.zh: 它会让人入睡。

example.en: The ones that fall to the wayside.
example.zh: 那些半途而废的。

fall by the wayside.note: 真题原文为 fall to the wayside（疑为 OCR 或变体），规范写 fall by the wayside

example.en: I’ve never done it before and I know that you’ve been doing it for ages.
example.zh: 我以前从没做过，而我知道你已经做了很久了。

example.en: It is a unique trait specific to the human race.
example.zh: 这是人类特有的独特特征。

example.en: The KaiOS devices offer an alternative to the more expensive models that remain out of reach of many Africans and contribute to the digital divide.
example.zh: KaiOS 设备为许多非洲人买不起的较贵机型提供了替代选择，而这些机型加剧了数字鸿沟。

example.en: I’ve never been to the head office, you know.
example.zh: 你知道的，我从没去过总部。

example.en: Nursing homes should be strictly limited in size.
example.zh: 养老院的规模应当受到严格限制。

example.en: Besides, I don’t think I could ever give up a good hot dog at a baseball game.
example.zh: 再说，我觉得我永远没法在棒球赛上放弃一份好吃的热狗。

example.en: It is the safety net for those who fall off the edge of existence.
example.zh: 它是为那些掉出生存边缘的人准备的安全网。

behind closed doors.zh: 私下里；在不公开的场合

example.en: These questions can reveal what it’s really like behind closed doors.
example.zh: 这些问题能揭示内部实际是什么样子。

behind closed doors.note: 例句为原句截取并简化

example.en: In certain countries, men can publicly hold hands as signs of brotherhood or friendship.
example.zh: 在某些国家，男性可以公开牵手，以表示兄弟情或友谊。

hold hands.note: 例句为原句截取并简化；字面义较明显，但属固定搭配，可复核

example.en: He was shaking hands with other members as they walked through the door.
example.zh: 他在其他成员走进门时和他们一一握手。

shake hands.note: 例句为原句截取并改写，建议复核

example.en: For example, women are more likely to experience disturbed sleep, anxiety and unusual fatigue before a heart attack.
example.zh: 例如，女性在心脏病发作前更可能出现睡眠紊乱、焦虑和异常疲劳。

example.en: Recently, the clothing industry has come under attack for creating a waste problem with serious environmental consequences.
example.zh: 最近，服装业因制造出带来严重环境后果的浪费问题而受到抨击。

example.en: Make eye contact or assess a student’s level of engagement.
example.zh: 进行眼神交流，或评估学生的参与程度。

example.en: It shows a daring foresight regarding future fine dining.
example.zh: 它显示出对未来高档餐饮的大胆远见。

example.en: More men than women are likely to stay in the labor force until their late seventies.
example.zh: 留在劳动力队伍中直到七十多岁的男性可能比女性更多。

example.en: Not all books are created equal, so parents need to choose the books they share with their children with great care.
example.zh: 并非所有书都一样好，所以父母要非常用心地挑选与孩子共读的书。

be created equal.note: 真题用法是否定式 not all ... are created equal（并非都一样）

example.en: A new systematic review brings us usefully up-to-date on the current findings in this area.
example.zh: 一项新的系统性综述让我们切实了解了该领域的最新发现。

example.en: Design brings together other subjects such as literature and art.
example.zh: 设计把文学、艺术等其他学科汇集在一起。

bring together.note: 例句为原句截取并简化

example.en: Their conclusions about what The Guardian described as this “sweet spot” are in line with the so-called Goldilocks
example.zh: 他们关于这个“最佳点”的结论与所谓的“金发姑娘原则”相符。

sweet spot.note: 原句被截断（只有一句），example 保留残句，建议复核

example.en: Kate placed the order and ran off to play.
example.zh: 凯特下了单，跑去玩了。

example.en: Artificial intelligence just isn't smart enough yet.
example.zh: 人工智能还不够聪明。

example.en: At the gate of a grade school in Kent.
example.zh: 在肯特郡一所小学的门口。

example.en: David Foulkes studies children to bring the secrets of their dreams to the light of day.
example.zh: 大卫·福克斯研究儿童，以揭开他们梦境的秘密。

bring sth to the light of day.note: 规范写法 bring sth to light；真题为 to the light of day；例句为原句截取（去掉括号）
